title: Senior UC Engineer
description:
The Senior UC Engineer will be part of Global Unified Communications Engineering team, supporting the design, delivery, and operational health of enterprise Unified Communications and Collaboration platforms across the Americas region. The role focuses on Cisco Webex Calling, Webex Contact Center, Voice Recording, Trading Turret (IPC Connexus), Telecom Service Provider relationships, and SIP Trunking, working closely with business units and stakeholders to ensure platforms remain reliable, secure, and well supported.

The candidate will serve as a key point of contact for incident management and vendor escalation across UC platforms, partnering with Cisco, telecom carriers, and other vendors to resolve issues quickly and minimize service impact. The role also involves supporting Red Sky (E911) emergency calling services and Microsoft Teams Meetings, monitoring platform health through observability and logging tools such as Splunk, and managing Call Detail Records (CDR) for reporting, troubleshooting, and compliance purposes.

The successful candidate will be required to demonstrate flexibility to support weekend maintenance and engineering changes as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Support and administer Cisco Webex Calling and Webex Contact Center platforms in production.
  • Manage and support Voice Recording platforms and ensure compliance with recording requirements.
  • Support Trading Turret systems (IPC Connexus) for trading floor voice communications.
  • Manage relationships and technical coordination with Telecom Service Providers.
  • Configure, support, and troubleshoot SIP Trunking connectivity across the environment.
  • Lead incident management for UC platform issues, including triage, escalation, and resolution.
  • Own vendor escalation processes for Cisco, telecom carriers, and other UC vendors.
  • Coordinate with business units and stakeholders on UC service requirements, changes, and incidents.
  • Support Red Sky (E911) emergency calling services and compliance requirements.
  • Support Microsoft Teams Meetings and related collaboration services.
  • Monitor UC platform health using observability and logging tools (Splunk).
  • Manage and analyze Call Detail Records (CDR) for reporting, troubleshooting, and compliance.
  • Demonstrate flexibility to work weekends and off-hours as needed to support planned engineering changes, maintenance windows, and critical deployments.
  • Continuously enhance documentation quality and drive knowledge-sharing practices across the team to reduce tribal knowledge and improve onboarding.
  • 10+ years of experience in Unified Communications engineering/support roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Webex Control Hub administration.
  • Strong knowledge of Webex Calling and Webex Contact Center architecture.
  • Familiarity with voice recording functionality and platforms.
  • Knowledge of network connectivity fundamentals as they relate to UC services.
  • Basic knowledge of network routing and bandwidth management.
  • Experience with UC observability and monitoring practices.
  • Experience with Splunk logging for UC platform monitoring.
  • Experience with CDR (Call Detail Record) management and analysis.
  • Experience with SIP Trunking and Telecom Service Provider coordination.
  • Experience with incident management and vendor escalation processes.

Nice to have:

  • Ability to use Copilot and other AI productivity tools to improve efficiency and productivity in day-to-day engineering and support work
  • Experience with trading floor communications/turret systems (IPC Connexus or similar) is a plus.
  • Experience with E911 solutions (Red Sky or similar) is a plus.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Teams Meetings/collaboration platforms.
  • Relevant Cisco certifications (e.g., CCNP Collaboration or similar) preferred.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.

  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. title: Remote Staff Software Engineer - Backend
description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About The Role


Dragos is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our team in building the leading xOT Security Platform. We work in a matrix style engineering organization which means in this role, you will be part of our Backend Community. To be successful at Dragos you will need to:



  • Be passionate about your craft, minding the details while working quickly.



  • Have a strong product sense and care deeply about the customers and problems we are solving.



  • Be self-directed with a strong work ethic and ability to operate autonomously.



  • Have excellent communication skills for remote collaboration, working well across engineering disciplines.



At Dragos, we don’t hire engineers whose only mission in life is to write code. We are looking for backend engineers who yearn to contribute to more than just a code base and who are willing to stretch themselves to accomplish the mission.



Responsibilities


Our backend community is the heartbeat of the Dragos Platform, playing a pivotal role in the success of our customers’ ability to secure their OT environments.


As a backend engineer you will:


Design and implement robust, testable, high-performance systems and tools in Rust.


Optimize existing software architectures to enhance speed and efficiency.


Actively participate in all phases of the development lifecycle, including debugging and optimization, ensuring and elevating software quality.


Stay informed about the latest advancements in Rust programming, security, and software design principles, helping to foster an environment of continuous learning and improvement.


Give and receive peer feedback on a normal cadence as part of our review cycle


Minimum Qualifications



  • 7+ years of experience developing backend systems in a fast paced, high performance team environment



  • 3+ years of experience in relational databases such as Postgres



  • 3+ years of experience with NoSQL databases such as Elasticsearch



  • 3+ years of experience working in a microservices architecture



  • Solid experience and understanding of Rust



  • Experience integrating with third party devices and data providers



  • Experience incorporating AI tools, models, or services into development workflows



  • Ability to lead technical decisions within a team or project scope


Additional Qualifications that Will Help You Succeed:



  • Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale with a focus on reliability



  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud‑native architectures



  • Experience with containerization (Docker)



  • Strong understanding of observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana)



  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines and working with IaC tools (Terraform)



  • Experience building information security–focused products or applying secure coding practices



  • Experience with Kotlin, Go, or Python in production environments



  • Experience mentoring team members or leading technical initiatives

title: Senior  Vice President
description:
Job Title:

Senior Vice President

Work Type:

Permanent

Location:

Embassy Park - Bengaluru

It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

The Opportunity

This is a role for a visionary technical leader who operates as a strategic force multiplier for the entire engineering organization. As a Principal Platform Engineer (SDE4) at NAB, you will be responsible for setting the long-term technical vision for critical domains of our engineering platform. You will tackle our most complex and ambiguous challenges, pioneering innovative solutions that advance the state-of-the-art for financial technology at scale. Your influence will extend far beyond the Platform Engineering & Developer Experience teams; you will collaborate with senior technology leaders, establish engineering standards, and mentor other senior engineers, shaping the technical fabric of the bank. If you are driven by the challenge of solving large-scale distributed systems problems and have a passion for creating an environment where hundreds of engineers can thrive, this is your platform to make a lasting impact.

What You'll Do

As a SDE4, your focus will be on strategy, architecture, and technical leadership, driving the long-term success and scalability of the NAB Engineering Foundation.

  • Define Technical Vision and Strategy: Define and own the long-term technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for critical platform domains, such as our enterprise container platform, multi-cloud infrastructure strategy, or core developer experience. Your work will set the direction for years to come.
  • Architect for the Future: Lead the architectural design of complex, cross-functional platform solutions. You will ensure these systems are secure, compliant, highly scalable, and cost-effective, anticipating future business needs and technological shifts.
  • Solve Ambiguous, Large-Scale Problems: Tackle the most technically challenging and ill-defined problems within the platform space. This involves deep-dive analysis, prototyping, and creating novel solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible.
  • Champion Engineering Excellence: Act as a steward for engineering quality across the orgs. You will establish and evangelize best practices, author design documents and RFCs, and lead by example to cultivate a culture of high-performance engineering.
  • Mentor and Elevate Senior Talent: Serve as a mentor and technical guide to other senior engineers (SDE3s) and team leads. You will be a "force multiplier," elevating the technical capabilities of the entire organization through your guidance and expertise.
  • Collaborate with Senior Leadership: Partner with senior technology leaders (Heads of Engineering) to align the platform strategy with NAB's overarching business and technology objectives, ensuring your work delivers maximum strategic value.

What You'll Bring

We are seeking a world-class engineer with a history of strategic impact and a reputation for technical excellence and thought leadership.

  • Experience: 9+ years of experience in software and platform engineering, with significant time spent in a technical leadership, staff, or principal engineer capacity.
  • Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep, recognized expertise in designing, building, and operating large-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems on multi-cloud platforms (AWS and Google Cloud / Azure).
  • Cloud-Native Authority: Mastery of Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem. You have architected and operated Kubernetes platforms at enterprise scale, likely in complex, multi-tenant environments, and have a profound understanding of its internals.
  • Strategic Influence: Proven ability to drive large-scale, cross-team technical initiatives from conception through to production. You are adept at building consensus and influencing technical direction without direct authority.
  • Exceptional Communication: World-class communication and interpersonal skills. You can crisply articulate highly complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, from junior engineers to executive leadership.
  • Visionary Mindset: A strategic thinker who can look beyond immediate problems to anticipate future challenges and opportunities, translating them into a coherent technical strategy.
  • AI Innovation: Lead organizational AI platform strategy and GenAI technology adoption. Design intelligent platforms with autonomous capabilities and predictive operations, like developer agents, code review agents, test agents, SRE agents etc.
  • Multi-Cloud architecture & Strategy: You have experience in designing and architecting, multi-cloud / cross-cloud-platform systems, and defining clear strategies for maintaining multi-cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Risk & Security: As part of being a banking / financial institution, security and risk in ingrained in our daily activity. A key competency would be not just building great tech but also building with the best practices of security & risk ingrained in our decisions and strategies.

Good to Have

These qualifications indicate a candidate operating at the forefront of the industry:

  • Demonstrable experience in defining and implementing AI-driven platform capabilities.
  • Active contributions to open-source projects within the cloud-native, infrastructure, or observability space.
  • Deep expertise with advanced deployment strategies (e.g., canary, blue-green) and modern continuous delivery platforms like Harness, especially in the context of highly regulated financial workloads.
  • Published work, such as conference talks, blog posts, or whitepapers, on topics related to platform engineering, distributed systems, or cloud architecture.

A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:

Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.

More focus on you:

We’re committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. We invest in our colleagues through world class development programs (Distinctive Leadership and Career Qualified in Banking), and empower you to learn, grow and pursue exciting career opportunities

This is your chance to join NAB India and along with your experience and expertise to help shape an innovation driven organisation that focuses on making a positive impact in the lives of its customers, colleagues and communities

description:

Location: 30700 West Patton (Wittmann Arizona)

Category: Test and Development

About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary As a Senior Development Engineer, you will lead hands-on prototype vehicle development, commissioning, and debug activities across vehicle software, instrumentation, and test assets. The role is centered on getting development vehicles, support assets, and custom test systems built, operational, and ready for field, chamber, track, and proving-ground use. Recent work in this role has included creating and modifying test vehicles, enabling ADAS test assets, executing software updates, and diagnosing vehicle-level issues on early-development platforms. Responsibilities End to end ownership of prototype vehicle commissioning and activation of early-development and test assets, including software bring-up, certificate provisioning, and restoring non-operational vehicles to usable condition. Diagnose and resolve vehicle-level software, electrical, and integration issues on development vehicles, including OTA failures, CAN-related faults, and unexpected system behavior in the field. Utilize, support or directly create software and controls concepts for prototype systems, including automated fault-injection or data-capture tools; develop and apply AI-assisted analysis tools for validation routine optimization. Execute and support development testing in dynamic, environmental, and off-road conditions. Collect, analyze, and interpret development data from CAN, vehicle networks, instrumentation, and logs to turn observations into actionable problem statements and next steps. Support ADAS and system-integration testing by preparing instrumentation, enabling target assets, configuring vehicles, and maintaining support infrastructure required for track and proving-ground execution. Provide practical technical support to peers and partner teams by helping configure development tools, debug setups, and transfer working knowledge needed to keep testing moving. Travel as needed (up to 50%) to support prototype vehicles, remote test events, environmental testing, proving-ground activity, and other high-urgency development work. Qualifications Strong hands-on engineering capability across vehicle systems, electrical integration, prototype hardware, and software-enabled development work. Experience commissioning, debugging, and supporting prototype or early-development vehicles. Working knowledge of low-voltage systems and controller / network integration. Experience with CAN and diagnostic/development tools such as CANalyzer, CANape, or similar analysis environments. Ability to troubleshoot across software, controls, wiring, network communication, and physical hardware integration boundaries. Experience building, modifying, or integrating prototype fixtures, instrumentation, support hardware, or custom development assets. Comfortable operating in ambiguous development environments where rapid problem solving, self-direction, and practical execution are required. Familiarity with Jira / Confluence workflows and documenting technical work clearly enough for cross-functional follow-through. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Mechatronics, Aerospace, or similar engineering discipline. 3+ years of automotive prototype, vehicle integration, or development engineering experience preferred. Pay Disclosure The salary range for this role is $93,800 - $117,200 for Arizona based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com. You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. Candidate Data Privacy and Technology Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. title: SoC Quality and Reliability Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

Google’s data centers are the most advanced in the world. In this role, you will help build the state-of-the art SoC’s that power these data centers by driving quality and reliability processes from the Integrated Circuit perspective. This is an opportunity to create silicon and follow it into the field (and back!) to drive improvements for the next-generations of chips.

In this role, you will understand Integrated circuit (IC) flows, wafer processing, testing, qualification, yield, reliability, and failure analysis. You will work with various cross-functional teams to develop quality and reliability specifications, develop and deploy design guidelines, and develop and execute and test plans. Within the larger organization you will collaborate with global hardware quality and reliability teams, silicon design, validation and engineering teams.The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
  • Drive the strategic definition and development of Design-for-Reliability (DfR) guidelines, collaborating with cross-functional subject matter experts to integrate reliability into early design stages.
  • Define and lead the development of qualification hardware and test methodologies, managing internal teams and external vendors to ensure robust silicon and package verification.
  • Execute comprehensive silicon and package qualification programs (including HTOL, ELFR, ESD/LU, b/HAST, etc.) and conduct in-depth failure analysis to resolve quality issues.
  • Extract and analyze large-scale data from qualification programs, high-volume manufacturing, and field returns to identify failure mechanisms and trends for yield and reliability optimization.
  • Develop and implement physics-based statistical Quality and Reliability models (e.g., ELF, TDDB, NBTI) to predict device failure mechanisms and lifetime behaviors.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in IC silicon quality or reliability.
  • Experience leading the product reliability life-cycle from post-tapeout through manufacturing.
  • Experience with semiconductor Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) technology, device physics, and failure mechanisms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related fields.
  • Experience in statistical data analysis using tools such as JMP, Python, or JSL.
  • Familiarity with Electrical Failure Analysis (EFA) and Physical Failure Analysis (PFA) techniques.
  • Knowledge of Design-for-Reliability (DfR) rules and implementation techniques.
  • Track record with silicon reliability on process nodes and advanced packaging technologies.

title: Vuoropäällikkö/ baarimestari (työkielenä suomi ja ruotsi), vakkari, KORPPOO/ PARAINEN
description:
Etsimme kokenutta vuoropäällikköä / baarimestaria vakituiseen työsuhteeseen viihtyisään hotellin ruoka- ja seurusteluravintolaan Korppooseen. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja työt pääsee aloittamaan viimeistään Lokakuun alkupuolella. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme Epassin!

Oletko ravintola-alan kokenut ammattilainen, joka nauttii saariston ainutlaatuisesta tunnelmasta ja ottaa mielellään vastuuta ravintolan arjesta? Haemme vahvistusta asiakkaamme ravintolaan henkilöstä, joka on saanut jo hieman kokemusta kyseisestä työstä. Työkielenä on suomi ja ruotsi.

Kesäsesonki on vilkas, talvella on rauhallisempaa. Kesäisin palvellaan alueen lukuisia matkailijoita ja turisteja, kun taas talvikaudella hotellilla majoittuu ja ruokailee erityisesti työporukoita.

Työnkuva ja odotukset

Haemme henkilöä, jolla on valmiutta ja varmuutta pyörittää ravintolan toimintaa itsenäisesti vuorossaan. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät vuoropäällikön vastuulliset tehtävät sekä laadukas baaritarjoilu.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Vankkaa kokemusta: Etsimme jo kannuksensa hankkinutta tekijää, jolta löytyy riittävästi näkemystä ja rutiinia ravintola-alalta.

  • Kielitaitoa: Sujuva ruotsin kielen taito on tehtävässä ehdoton edellytys, sillä palvelemme asiakkaitamme kaksikielisessä saaristoympäristössä.

  • Itsenäistä työotetta: Pystyt tekemään ratkaisuja ja huolehtimaan ravintolan sujuvasta arjesta omatoimisesti.

Tarjoamme sinulle

  • Vakituisen työsuhteen: Työtunteja on talvikaudella vähintään 30 h/viikko (mahdollisuus lisätunteihin), ja kesäsesongin aikana työtunnit joustavat sesongin tarpeiden mukaan.

  • Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen: Maksamme osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaisen sopimuspalkan.

  • Edullisen asumisen: Järjestämme käyttöösi asunnon saaristosta edulliseen 300–400 €/kk hintaan.

  • Sujuvan perehdytyksen: Pääset hyppäämään mukaan tehtävään huolellisella perehdytyksellä. Työt alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, viimeistään Lokakuun alkupuolella.

Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.
Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!



---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Patient Safety and Anti-Counterfeiting (GRACC) Internship (Basel, 3-6 months)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Counterfeit medicines and diagnostic products pose a significant risk to the safety of patients. Counterfeit products can be found in any country and often look identical to authentic versions, making them difficult to detect, particularly for patients. Patients believe they are taking the right treatment, but they are actually at risk. The counterfeits may contain too much or too little of the active ingredients, or none at all, preventing patients from receiving the proper treatment. Even worse, counterfeits are made with toxic substances or ineffective preparations that can cause serious illness or even death.

Counterfeiting is an illegal activity that has serious consequences for public health and patient safety. That’s why Roche is fully committed to working with health authorities and law enforcement agencies worldwide to aid their investigations into the source of counterfeits and prevent their distribution. We employ several anti-counterfeit strategies to combat this global threat to public health and help ensure the integrity of our products, and we are committed to giving healthcare professionals and patients the information they need to safely access them.

The opportunity

You will support the GRACC team in executing vital anti-counterfeiting strategies, ensuring the integrity of our global supply chain, and helping to protect patients from the dangers of counterfeit medicines. Furthermore, you will

  • Assist in the ongoing development and monitoring of Roche's anti-counterfeit strategies and supply chain security initiatives.

  • Support the creation of educational materials and communications aimed at healthcare professionals and patients to help them recognize authentic products and avoid counterfeits.

  • Help coordinate efforts between internal teams, health authorities, and law enforcement agencies to aid in tracking and investigating counterfeit sources.

  • Assist in tracking global counterfeiting trends and data to help the team identify potential vulnerabilities in the market.

Who you are

You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (ideally in Public Health, Supply Chain Management, Life Sciences, Law, or Business). In addition, you have:

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft/Google applications (Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint). Experience with data tracking or risk analysis tools is a plus.

  • A strong interest in patient safety, global supply chain security, regulatory affairs, and public health policy.

  • A team player mindset who thinks outside the box, shares their ideas, and has a strong ethical commitment to safeguarding patient health and well-being.

  • Proficiency in English.

Additional information

  • Start Date: September - October 2026

  • Workload: 100%

  • Duration: Minimum 3 months, up to 6 months

  • Location: on-site

  • It is not possible to write a thesis during the internship.

Application process

  • Please submit your application, including a CV and a motivation letter.

  • A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying) OR recent graduates are also eligible to start an internship with us within 12 months of their graduation date.

  • For non-EU/EFTA citizens: Certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory (required due to regulations).

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: SAP Programme Manager
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a SAP Programme Delivery Manager to join our IT team here at Harrods. The role will be accountable for the planning, adherence to established governance models and delivery of SAP-related change initiatives across S/4HANA, EWM, CAR, BW/4HANA and associated integrations.

About the Role

This role is pivotal in shaping and managing the SAP change portfolio across multiple business and technology domains, providing leadership across continuous improvement initiatives, business demand, ERP-enabled CapEx projects, upgrade readiness activities and future platform upgrades. You will lead SAP project delivery from initiation through to implementation and benefits realisation, ensuring all change is aligned to strategic priorities, business value and organisational capacity. Working across multiple workstreams and suppliers, you will manage key dependencies to deliver efficient, predictable and high-quality outcomes.

A key focus of the role will be leading the SAP Technical Debt Remediation Programme and preparing the organisation for its planned ERP upgrade in H1 2028. You will oversee demand management, backlog prioritisation and continuous improvement activities, ensuring investment decisions and change requests are assessed against strategic objectives, technical constraints and delivery capacity. In addition, you will provide robust governance, reporting and stakeholder management, supporting steering groups and investment forums while maintaining clear visibility of scope, costs, risks, schedules and benefits.

About You

The successful candidate will bring significant experience leading large-scale SAP programmes and complex technology change initiatives within enterprise environments. You will have a strong track record of delivering projects in SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP platforms, with a solid understanding of project governance, portfolio management and change delivery. Acting as the primary delivery lead, you will be confident coordinating internal teams, Application Management Service providers and strategic partners to ensure successful outcomes aligned to business, architectural and financial objectives.

You will possess experience in SAP technical debt remediation, Clean Core principles and supporting major SAP upgrades and transformation programmes. A working knowledge of SAP EWM, CAR, BW/4HANA and related integration technologies will be highly advantageous, alongside the ability to operate effectively within complex multi-supplier environments. Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills are essential, and experience within the retail sector would be particularly beneficial.

About Us

Harrods is one of the world’s leading luxury department stores and we’re becoming a destination for top designers, and the most sought-after brands from around the globe. Our combined mission is to make visiting our iconic Knightsbridge store one of the world’s most inspiring shopping experiences.

Our Promise to You

Help us make the impossible possible for our customers and we’ll do something remarkable for you. As well as offering a friendly environment to inspire your best work, we provide abundant opportunities and support to build an exceptional career across the varied specialisms of our business.

Uniquely You

Whilst our job adverts outline the ideal qualities, skills, and prior experience for the role, we believe in the potential for growth and value individual strengths. If you can demonstrate the majority of skills and strong experience to thrive in this role, we would encourage you to apply.

At Harrods we believe the personality and authenticity of our people sets us apart. We celebrate and invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds, tastes, and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. What makes you unique makes us exceptional.

If you want to know more about life at Harrods, search #TogetherHarrods on LinkedIn, or follow us on Instagram @togetherharrods.

title: Hostess Delivery
description:
BAS World is Europa’s grootste platform voor de koop en verkoop van Trucks, Trailers, Bedrijfswagens en Equipment. Vanuit ons vernieuwde delivery centrum in Veghel zorgen we er iedere dag voor dat klanten niet zomaar een voertuig ophalen, maar een moment beleven waar ze naar uitkijken. En dat begint bij jou.

Als Hostess ben jij het eerste gezicht dat onze klanten zien. Jij ontvangt ze met een warm welkom, houdt overzicht in de klantruimte en zorgt dat alles achter de schermen soepel verloopt. Ben jij vlot, spontaan en heb je geen moeite om de touwtjes in handen te nemen? Dan zoeken we jou. Ook als je nog aan het begin van je carrière staat: we leiden je graag zelf op.

Dit is een nieuwe functie binnen ons team: je bouwt de rol samen met ons op en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Arrival & Delivery.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Klanten hartelijk verwelkomen en op hun gemak stellen;

  • De klantruimte overzien: wie wacht waarop, en wie is er als volgende aan de beurt;

  • Afleveringen en orders slim verdelen over onze afleverspecialisten;

  • De mailbox van Delivery scherp bijhouden, zodat niets blijft liggen;

  • Documenten voorbereiden voor de aflevering, inclusief het checken van de juiste douanedocumenten;

  • Zelfstandig een tenaamstelling uitvoeren via het RDW-proces: jij regelt het, wij vertrouwen erop;

  • Ondersteunen bij het verzenden van waardevolle voertuigdocumenten.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een sleutelrol in ons gloednieuwe, vernieuwde delivery centrum;

  • Een mooie eerste stap in jouw carrière, met goede begeleiding en ruimte om te leren;

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen, binnen een hecht en gezellig team;

  • Oneindige doorgroeimogelijkheden. Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière;

  • Werken binnen een snelgroeiende, internationale organisatie waar geen dag hetzelfde is;

  • Deelname aan het BAS Fit sportprogramma en vers fruit op kantoor;

  • Teamuitjes, borrels en natuurlijk het BAS Jaarfeest

  • Veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief;

  • Je staat aan het begin van je carrière of hebt net wat werkervaring: we leren je de rest graag zelf;

  • Hospitality- of front-office-ervaring is een pluspunt, maar geen vereiste;

  • Je spreekt goed Engels; Duits, Spaans of een andere vreemde taal is een mooi extra;

  • Je houdt je hoofd koel en het overzicht scherp, precies op het moment dat het druk wordt;

  • Je hebt een positieve, spontane uitstraling waarmee je iedereen meteen op zijn gemak stelt.

Wij zijn BAS!

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen?

Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop.

title: Endoscopy Technician - Laredo Digestive Health Center
description:
Why Join Us?

  • Be Valued for What You Bring to the Team – Competitive pay that rewards your hard work
  • Benefits You Can Count On – Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage
  • Work Hard. Recharge Often. – Generous PTO and extended illness benefits
  • Invest in Your Future – 401(k) with company match
  • Grow With Us – Career development, learning opportunities, and advancement pathways
  • We Invest in Your Success – Licensure and certification reimbursement for eligible roles
  • Student Loan Support – Assistance available for eligible roles
  • Your Wins Deserve Recognition – Employee rewards and recognition programs
  • A Team You'll Love Working With – A collaborative, purpose-driven culture making a difference every day
  • Additional Voluntary Benefits – Choose from options such as pet insurance, identity protection, and legal insurance.

Great people. Great benefits. Meaningful work. Join us and make an impact.

Job Summary

The Endoscopy Technician supports high-quality, patient-centered care by assisting with endoscopic procedures and maintaining equipment to ensure safety and compliance. Performs technical and specialized duties under the supervision of a Registered Nurse, including preparing procedure rooms, cleaning and disinfecting endoscopic equipment, and ensuring proper inventory of supplies. Plays a vital role in facilitating efficient procedures and maintaining accurate documentation.

Essential Functions

  • Prepares procedure rooms and ensures proper setup of equipment, instruments, and supplies for each endoscopic procedure.
  • Assists procedural teams by anticipating the needs of the physician and supporting patient positioning during procedures.
  • Cleans, decontaminates, and performs high-level disinfection of endoscopic equipment according to manufacturer guidelines and facility policies.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves issues with endoscopes and related equipment to minimize procedural delays.
  • Ensures proper handling, labeling, and documentation of specimens and cultures in accordance with policy.
  • Monitors and maintains inventory of supplies, ensuring all items are in stock and removing expired items as needed.
  • Maintains accurate department records, including quality control documentation for decontamination and equipment maintenance.
  • Assists with scheduling, preoperative calls, and medical record organization to support procedural readiness.
  • Transports patients and supplies as necessary, ensuring timely and safe movement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Completion of an accredited Endoscopy Technician or sterile processing program preferred
  • 0-2 years of healthcare experience required
  • 1-3 years of previous endoscopy experience preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of endoscopic procedures, equipment maintenance, and disinfection protocols.
  • Strong understanding of aseptic techniques and infection control standards.
  • Ability to anticipate procedural needs and respond effectively to physician and team requirements.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills to manage supplies, documentation, and patient transport.
  • Proficiency in using communication tools to address concerns and resolve issues.
  • Commitment to maintaining a safe and patient-centered care environment.

Licenses and Certifications

  • BCLS - Basic Life Support Issued by American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross (ARC) or American Safety and Health Institute (ASHI) required
  • Certified Medical Assistant (CMA)-AAMA preferred or
  • CNA - Certified Nursing Assistant preferred or
  • Certified Patient Care Technician (CPCT) preferred

State Specific Requirements

  • Indiana: SGNA course within six (6) months of employment.
  • New Mexico: GI certification or Certified Surgical Technologist (CST) or Certified Operating Room Surgical Technologist (CORST) preferred.
  • Pennsylvania: SGNA course within six (6) months of employment.
  • Texas: Successful completion of assigned SAMA course within 30 days of hire required.

title: Myymäläpäällikkö -harjoittelija, 37.5h/vko, JYSK Savonlinna
description:
Motivoidutko ja silmäsi syttyvät esihenkilövastuusta ja omasta myymälästä? Oletko valmis ottamaan vastuun omasta kehittymisestäsi kanssamme ja tavoittelemaan omaa JYSK myymälää 1-2 vuoden sisällä?

Meillä ratkaisee asenne ja tavoitteellisuus tehdä tulosta. Meillä myymäläpäällikkö -traineet saavat vastuuta, koulutusta ja tilaisuuden kasvaa nopeastikin myymäläpäälliköiksi. Meillä voit luoda uraa, ja tavoitella tulevaisuudessa vaikka Aluepäällikön tehtävää.

Tutustu ja lue lisää myymäläpäällikkö -trainee tehtävästä JYSKissä.

MYYMÄLÄPÄÄLLIKKÖ -TRAINEEN TYÖ JYSKISSÄ

  • Ensimmäisen vuoden aikana opettelet työtä eri JYSK myymälöissä, ja saat kykyjesi ja näyttöjen perusteella vastuullesi erilaisia projekteja jotka liittyvät myymäläpäällikön rooliin ja siihen kasvamiseen.
  • Tavoitteet ohjaavat työtäsi: meillä jokaisella on selkeä suunta ja halu ylittää odotukset.
  • Vaihtelevat ja työntäyteiset työpäiväsi koostuvat mm. myynnistä, tiimin johtamisesta, varastotyöstä, asiakaspalvelusta ja kassatyöstä.
  • Lisäksi saat vastuullisesi osaamisen karttuessa eri vastuutehtäviä niin esihenkilötyöhön kuin myymälän myynnilliseen johtamiseen liittyen. Toimit tiiviisti myymäläpäällikön työparina, ja sinulla on myös oma mentori.
  • Viikoittaisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu myös aktiivinen palautteenantaminen tiimille auttaen heitä onnistumaan työssään.
  • Lisäksi osallistut ensimmäisenä vuotenasi JYSKin omaan myymäläpäällikköharjoittelija koulutusohjelmaan, joka kestää noin vuoden. Koulutukset tapahtuvat Vantaan pääkonttorilla viikon jaksoissa (yhteensä 5 jaksoa).
  • Työ vaatii hyvää peruskuntoa, mutta saat käyttöösi parhaat työvälineet ja tiimin tuen.
  • Monipuolisuutta – myymälä, varasto, kampanjat… tylsyys ei kuulu sanavarastoomme.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA

  • Sinulla on motivaatiota tehdä töitä esihenkilönä ja johtaa tiimiä omalla esimerkilläsi tuloksiin.
  • Tunnet muiden kouluttamisen, perehdyttämisen ja aktiivisen palautteenantamisen osaksi omia vahvuuksiasi.
  • Valmiutta ja halua matkustaa sekä työskennellä eri JYSK myymälöissä ensimmäisen vuoden aikana. Tänä aikana sinua koulutetaan, ja perehdytetään työhön erikokoisissa myymälöissä, kartutat taitojasi ja näkemystä ottaa myymäläpäällikön työ haltuun 1-2 vuoden kuluttua.
  • Kunnianhimoa nousta myymäläpäälliköksi. Kun tilaisuus myymäläpäälliköksi avautuu, se ei välttämättä ole kotipaikkakunnaltasi, joten toivomme sinulta joustoa. Me tuemme mahdollisessa muutossa ja siihen liittyvissä kustannuksissa.
  • Olet parhaimmillasi kiireessä ja nopeatempoisessa ympäristössä. Tykkäät nopeatempoisesta työtahdista ja yllättävistäkin työtehtävistä kesken työvuoron.
  • Olet myyntihenkinen, ja tuloksellisuus sekä tavoitteiden ylittäminen ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita työssäsi. Haluat myös myydä ja menestyä joka työvuorossa.
  • Siedät keskeneräisyyttä, koska tekemistä on paljon ja kaikkea ei aina voi saada valmiiksi kerralla.
  • Osaat palautua epäonnistumisista nopeasti, ja näet senkin jälkeen uudet asiat mielenkiintoisina haasteina, joihin tarttua positiivisella tekemisen energialla.
  • Olet joustava sekä tehtävien että työtuntien ja työaikojen suhteen. Töitä tehdään vaihtelevasti eri vuoroissa aamulla, illalla kuin viikonloppuisinkin.
  • Olet muita kunnioittava kollega, tulosta tekevä kauppias ja sitoutunut tekemään töitä sovittujen asioiden eteen ripeällä tekemisen meiningillä.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE

  • Palkkaus kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.
  • Peruspalkan ja lisien lisäksi myymäläpäällikkö-traineella on oma vuosittain määriteltävä bonusohjelma
  • Kattavalla perehdytysohjelmalla sekä myymäläpäällikön tuella opit nopeasti työn, voit näyttää taitosi.
  • Työvuorosuunnittelumme tukee palautumista ja työssäjaksamista.
  • Meillä on turvallinen työympäristö, jossa työn fyysisyyttä on auttamassa erilaisia apuvälineitä, ja aktiivinen ja avoin keskustelu myymälässä tukee henkistä jaksamista ja hyvää yhteishenkeä.
  • Meillä on töissä hauskaa ja vauhdikasta. Saat ympärillesi loistavat tiimikaverit.
  • Henkilökunta-alennus, työterveyspalvelut, vuosittainen Edenred liikunta- ja kulttuurietu, JYSK Awards -palkintogaala.
  • Mahdollisuuden kilpailla, voittaa ja juhlia tiimin kanssa – kyllä, meillä on kisat ja palkinnot!
  • Olemme vakavarainen vähittäiskauppaketju, joka tarjoaa vahvan pohjan rakentaa monipuolista uraa tulevaisuudessa omien kykyjesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan.

Työnantajan toimintaohjeiden ymmärrys ja suorassa asiakaspalvelukontaktissa toimiminen edellyttävät tehtävään valitulta hakijalta hyvää kirjallista ja suullista suomenkielentaitoa.

Mahdolliset tiedustelut: Myymäläpäällikkö Anne Luukkonen, SMF919@jysk.com

REKRYTOINTIPROSESSI

Hakemuksia käsitellään aktiivisesti jo hakuaikana. Valinta tehtävään tehdään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä. Viestimme sinulle sähköpostitse hakuprosessin etenemisestä viiden (5) arkipäivän sisällä hakemuksesi lähettämisestä.

Jos pääset seuraavaan vaiheeseen, se on ajasta ja paikasta riippumaton videohaastattelu, jossa pääset kertomaan lyhyesti lisää itsestäsi. Kutsu videohaastatteluun lähetetään sähköpostilla, joten seuraathan sähköpostiasi. Jos saat henkilökohtaisen kutsun videohaastatteluun, siihen tulee vastata kolmen (3) päivän sisällä.

Hakemukset käsitellään luottamuksellisesti rekrytoivan esihenkilötiimin toimesta.

MEISTÄ

Me uskomme, että avainasemassa menestykseemme ovat työntekijämme. Siksi tarjoamme jatkuvasti koulutusta ja erilaisia urapolkuja. Sen jälkeen, kun perustajamme Lars Larsen avasi ensimmäisen myymälänsä Tanskassa vuonna 1979, JYSK on laajentunut maailmalaajuiseksi ketjuksi. Meillä on myymälöitä ja verkkokauppoja ympäri maailman.

Kolme JYSKin perusarvoa – kauppias, kollega ja yrityshenki – ilmaisevat käyttäytymistä ja asennetta, joita voimme odottaa toisiltamme. Luotamme toisiimme, ja uskomme valtuuttamiseen vapaudella ja vastuulla tehdä. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijöidemme pitkistä työurista ja sitoutumisesta. Olemme tutkitustikin yksi Suomen parhaista työpaikoista. Oikeanlaisella asenteella, JYSKissä on tarjolla monenlaisia mahdollisuuksia. Lue lisää arvoistamme linkin takaa: JYSK työpaikkana ja arvomme

Kannustamme kaikkia hakemaan avoimia tehtäviämme sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä taustasta, uskonnosta tai muista henkilökohtaisista ominaisuuksista riippumatta. Lue lisää monimuotoisuustyöstämme linkin takaa: Monimuotoisuustyö JYSKissä

title: External Supply Chain Program Manager, WWOS, WWOS External Supply Chain
description:
We are looking for a program manager to coordinate investigations and escalations across our external supply chain businesses to ensure that loss events across Amazon Freight, Ship with Amazon, and WePay inbound shippers flow to the correct investigation teams globally, with proper signals and minimal false positives. Today, external supply chain escalations involve multiple systems (MVP, RIVER, SSTP, Lasik), multiple investigation teams (AMER Investigations, Cluster LP, CIRS), and false positives that consume investigator bandwidth. This role will own the escalation architecture for our external supply chain businesses globally, end to end: governance, automation, standards alignment, and continuous improvement. You will be the connective tissue between detection signals and investigation action.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the global escalation matrix for external supply chain loss events (SWA, AF, WePay)
- Govern and continuously improve routing logic: FM/MM events to AMER Investigations via MVP; UTR/LM events to Cluster LP via RIVER
- Drive false positive reduction to target threshold through triage team optimization and signal refinement
- Activate and maintain the Blue-Flag process and Lasik integration for external supply chain theft signals
- Build communication automation: WWOS to SWA notifications on case creation (currently manual, target automated)
- Manage camera access provisioning and training for triage teams across 21+ SCs
- Standardize LE engagement SOPs and police report filing processes globally
- Coordinate daily with SSTP and Relay to reduce false positives and improve signal quality
- Align external supply chain investigation standards across AMER, EU, and India
- Define and maintain escalation protocols for theft incidents aligned with business stakeholders (Tier 1/2/3 response)


A day in the life
You start by reviewing overnight SSTP alerts, triaging which signals are real and which are noise. You update the Blue-Flag escalation logic in Lasik based on a new MO pattern Pat flagged yesterday. Mid-day you're training a new batch of SWA triage team members on camera access and case formatting. After lunch you pull false positive data to quantify the impact of last week's filter refinement. You close with a cross-regional sync aligning AMER, EU, and India investigation teams on a standardized LE engagement SOP.

About the team
The External Supply Chain team protects Amazon's freight and parcel movements across Amazon Freight, Ship with Amazon, and WePay inbound shippers globally. These businesses serve a range of models (business to business, business to customer, and customer to customer) where volume moves through third-party carriers, shipper warehouses, terminals, and Amazon's own network with limited visibility. The team designs, pilots, and scales solutions (seals, supervised handoffs, IoT tracking, tiered shipper security frameworks) that close visibility and chain-of-custody gaps where Amazon has historically had the fewest controls. Success is measured in loss dollars reduced, claims prevented, Network Standards established, and shipper trust earned as a competitive differentiator.

title: Research Director, Semiconductor
description:
This role is based in our NEO Building office.

Role Overview

Omdia is seeking a qualified and motivated Research Director to head our China Semiconductor research practice. This role combines hands-on research expertise with team leadership and strategic oversight, managing a local team of 3 analysts. The Research Director will focus primarily on China Semiconductor Landscape research while maintaining responsibility for the entire China Semiconductor practice, including Semiconductor Manufacturing and Semiconductor Components (MCU, power semiconductors and sensors). The position reports directly to the Senior Director, Semiconductor Research and requires a balance of product delivery, strategic planning, and team management.

The Research Director will work alongside functional teams located across multiple locations in Europe, APAC and North America. This role requires building and maintaining extensive industry networks, establishing thought leadership, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality market intelligence to our local and global client base. The Research Director will also be required to undertake domestic and international travel for research and business development purposes.

Research Leadership & Strategy

Team Management & Development

Build and maintain position as a leading expert through regular publication of market insights and trend analysis, industry commentary, conference presentations, and panel participation

6+ years of experience in the China semiconductor industry with demonstrated understanding of:

Strong leadership presence with proven ability to influence across organizational structures.

Business Acumen

Strategic thinking combined with operational execution capabilities.

Our goal is to provide the care each of us would want for ourselves or for our family members, in the right setting, and at the right time.


Today, we are serving thousands of patients in our value-based care model and the number is growing every day. If you want to bring your experience, skill and passion to make a lasting impact in healthcare, we’d like to meet you.

About the Role


Hopscotch Primary Care is looking for a skilled Front End Engineer to support our Engineering and Product teams at a pivotal moment in our growth. The ideal candidate will blend technical execution, effective cross-functional collaboration, and an ownership mindset to excel in our fast-paced, dynamic environment. Our data-driven care model relies on a strong technical foundation to power our clinical operations, analytics, and patient engagement. This role will play a critical role in building a best-in-class product ecosystem that scales as we grow across new markets. In our highly collaborative team, you will work closely with Product, Operations, Growth and Clinical teams to execute our technology roadmap.


What You’ll Do



  • Develop and maintain applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and accessibility

  • Design and implement ‘last-mile’ data pipelines to enrich or re-shape backend data for optimal use in applications

  • Collaborate with design and product teams to translate wireframes and prototypes into high-quality code

  • Build, evolve and maintain our design system and component library in partnership with product

  • Support code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure high standards across the tech stack

  • Proactively identify and address performance bottlenecks or UX issues

  • Contribute to front end technical strategy, system architecture, and internal documentation for long-term scalability

  • Develop a deep understanding of the current architecture and technology roadmap

  • Build relationships with cross-functional partners and effectively communicate about priorities and work product


About You:


You would be a great fit for this position if you have:



  • 3–5 years of professional front end engineering experience using JavaScript/TypeScript, React (or similar) and component-based UI development, ideally with Healthcare experience

  • Experience supporting a hybrid model of in-house development and vended solutions

  • Experience with state management, API integration, and rendering data-rich interfaces

  • Experience working with backend systems or data tools to shape or transform data (ex. SQL, Python, dbt, or similar)

  • Familiarity with working with healthcare data sources, different interfaces and clinical workflow software including EHR, population health tools, patient portals, and clinical decision support technology.

  • Familiarity with front end testing frameworks

  • Experience in a start-up or high-growth environment, ideally in healthcare

  • A results-driven mindset, focusing time and resources against the most impactful priorities

  • A concise and articulate communication style, breaking complex concepts down both verbally and in writing


From a cultural perspective, you are:



  • Customer-focused with a passion for serving patients and providers who make healthcare possible

  • Agile, yet thoughtful, and can work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment

  • Constantly seeking ways to simplify and improve current processes, bringing a positive attitude to challenges

  • Accountable, holding yourself and others to a high standard and seeking to support and develop others

  • Willing to roll up your sleeves to support the work required and collaborate effectively with people of all backgrounds

  • Reliable, driving towards clarity and delivering on your commitments

  • Energized by building relationships and finding creative solutions to arrive at mutually beneficial outcomes

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and bring a structured, proactive approach to getting things done

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we embrace diversity, invest in a culture of inclusion and positivity and encourage all to apply to join our team. title: Remote Software Engineer, Ios Core Product - Baton Rouge, La, Usa
description:

description:

title: Remote Staff Software Engineer (React Native)
description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

Overview

At PrizePicks, we are changing the game in daily fantasy sports. We are a passionate team of innovators dedicated to creating a best-in-class experience for our members. Our engineering team builds and scales the platform that powers our explosive growth — from our consumer-facing mobile app to the services that handle millions of daily transactions. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Overall Game Experience (OGX) team and help us continue to build the future of fantasy sports.


Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Staff Software Engineer with deep expertise in TypeScript and React Native to join our Overall Game Experience team. In this role, you will design, build, and own critical features within PrizePicks’ React Native mobile application — including developer experience and tooling, deployment pipelines and CI/CD workflows, large-scale refactors, and overall app health and performance. You will tackle high-scope, complex technical problems, define the technical path from product idea to production, and mentor engineers across your team and the organization. This is a role for someone who thrives on crafting exceptional mobile experiences and wants to have a direct impact on a product used by millions.



What You’ll Do

  • Own technical direction: Set and evolve the technical standards, architecture, and best practices for your team’s mobile features, ensuring long-term scalability and maintainability of the app.

  • Lead the hardest problems: Own the design and delivery of the team’s most complex, highest-scope projects — the ones that require deep technical judgment and cross-system thinking.

  • Drive team efficiency: Identify and implement improvements to developer tooling, build pipelines, and development workflows that enable the entire team to iterate faster and ship with more confidence.

  • Establish engineering practices: Define and enforce standards for component architecture, testing, accessibility, performance, and mobile deployment across the team.

  • Mentor all engineers: Provide mentorship to engineers at every level on the team, shaping technical growth, raising the quality bar, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate at the organizational level: Work with Engineering Managers, Product leadership, and other Staff/Principal engineers to align technical strategy with business objectives.

  • Own cross-stack integration: Ensure the mobile app integrates effectively with backend services (Go and Rails), driving consistency in API contracts and data flows across the platform.

  • Participate in on-call rotation: Own systemic reliability improvements and lead incident response for the most critical production issues.


What You Have

Experience:



  • 8–10 years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise building production React Native applications at scale

  • Proven track record of owning multiple complex technical initiatives and driving them to successful outcomes across a team

  • Experience with the full mobile development lifecycle at scale — architecture, build systems, deployment pipelines, and post-release monitoring

  • Experience building mobile applications backed by large-scale, high-throughput distributed systems serving millions of users

  • History of elevating engineering teams through mentorship, standards-setting, and technical leadership


Technical Skills:



  • Mastery-level TypeScript proficiency — you are a reference point for TypeScript best practices, patterns, and type system usage

  • Deep React Native expertise — you have solved hard problems around performance, native modules, complex animations, and cross-platform consistency

  • Expert experience with Expo and its ecosystem, monorepo tooling (Yarn workspaces), and mobile build/release infrastructure

  • Strong understanding of mobile testing strategies at scale — Jest, Maestro for E2E testing, and quality automation

  • Proficiency with CI/CD for mobile and Expo/EAS workflows — automated builds, OTA updates, staged rollouts, app store pipelines

  • Understanding of backend API patterns — you can read, reason about, and influence API design across Go and Rails services


Working Style:



  • Operates with full autonomy — you define your own work and the work of the team based on what matters most

  • Exceptional communicator who can represent technical strategy to engineering leadership and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experienced in fully remote engineering organizations

  • Comfortable making high-stakes technical decisions with incomplete information


What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools across the full development lifecycle — coding, planning, scoping, and code review

  • Vision for how AI tooling and agentic coding practices can accelerate team productivity and improve engineering outcomes


Where You’ll Live

While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates. #LI-Remote

The typical salary range for this position is $195,000 to $200,000 At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. title: Remote Staff Backend Engineer, Host Pricing & Availability
description:

title: Senior Associate - Trans Compliance
description:
About CleanHarbors
Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.
Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. title: Lid Centrale Cliëntenraad (CCR)
description:
Heb jij een hart voor mensen met een verstandelijke beperking en wil je jouw betrokkenheid inzetten waar het écht verschil maakt?

Bij Prisma vinden we het belangrijk dat cliënten en hun naasten een stem hebben in de keuzes die we maken. Goede gehandicaptenzorg maken we immers samen. Als lid van de Centrale Cliëntenraad (CCR) zorg jij ervoor dat die stem écht wordt gehoord door de Raad van Bestuur. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar als volwaardige gesprekspartner. Wil jij jouw ervaring en frisse blik inzetten binnen een warme en betrokken raad? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Jouw rol binnen de CCR

Medezeggenschap klinkt misschien officieel, maar betekent vooral dat je samen nadenkt over de zorg van vandaag en morgen. Je denkt actief mee over belangrijke onderwerpen, zoals de kwaliteit van zorg, de toekomst van de organisatie en het welzijn van cliënten.

Als lid van de CCR vertegenwoordig je de gezamenlijke belangen van cliënten. Dit vraagt ongeveer 4 uur per maand.

Je:

  • brengt jouw ervaring in en denkt actief en constructief mee over nieuw beleid.

  • voert regelmatig gesprekken met cliënten of lokale bewonersraden om te horen wat er leeft.

  • neemt deel aan het CCR overleg, ongeveer één bijeenkomst, vergadering of werkbezoek per maand.

Een CCR lid vertelt:

"Praten over keuzes die er echt toe doen, dat doe je als lid van de CCR. We werken samen met betrokken mensen in een open sfeer waarin ook veel ruimte is om te lachen!"

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een betrokken en nieuwsgierig persoon met een warm hart voor de gehandicaptenzorg. Je kijkt verder dan je eigen situatie en denkt in kansen voor het gezamenlijke belang. Daarnaast herken je jezelf hierin:

  • Je bent bijvoorbeeld een naaste, wettelijk vertegenwoordiger, mentor of vrijwilliger van een cliënt.

  • Je communiceert op een constructieve, kritische en verbindende manier

Wat bieden wij?

Onze CCR-leden zijn ontzettend waardevol voor Prisma. Daarom bieden wij jou:

  • Betekenisvol werk: Je weet dat jouw bijdrage helpt om de zorg voor onze cliënten elke dag een stukje beter te maken.

  • Een warm team: Samenwerken met gepassioneerde collega's in een open, gezellige sfeer.

  • Vergoeding: Een nette regeling voor de vergoeding van je reis- en onkosten.

  • Zachte landing: Twijfel je nog? Je hoeft niet direct 'ja' te zeggen. Je kunt altijd eerst een keer aanschuiven óf 3 maanden als aspirant-lid meedraaien. Zo krijg je rustig de tijd om te aarden en de organisatie te leren kennen.

Enthousiast geworden?

Wil jij het verschil maken voor onze cliënten? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren! Stuur een mailtje naar ccr@prismanet.nl om je interesse te tonen of om een keer vrijblijvend koffie te komen drinken.

Heb je vooraf nog inhoudelijke vragen over de rol? Neem dan contact op met Karim Hammadi (bestuurssecretaris) via khammadi@prismanet.nl.

Wellicht ontmoet je binnenkort onze trotse CCR-leden. Wij kunnen niet wachten om kennis met je te maken!

title: Senior User Experience Researcher, Google Ads
description:
As a researcher in Customer Engagement (CE) you will be an advocate for both the Google customer and our internal users who make great support experiences possible. Empower Google to intelligently engage customers and help them succeed at scale. You will focus on the customer empower Google’s customers and the Googlers who serve them. Focus on Ads and the Ads-supported consumer space. You will bring transformational changes with AI Partner with ML/AI teams to reduce tedium and increase velocity, allowing users to focus on human-only nuances and perspectives. You will drive broader adoption, resulting in a better understanding of Google’s customers which powers insightful suggestions and helps our customers achieve success.

This role works on a program that evaluates current AI experiences and sets the direction for both near-term improvements and the long-term goal for support experiences. Collecting and analyzing user behaviors, needs and challenges related to usage and AI experiences across a variety of products. Translate findings into compelling narratives and strategic recommendations that guide product prioritization and enhance AI model quality. Collaborate closely with fellow researchers, design, product manager, and engineering to build a holistic understanding of the user experience, integrating insights from multiple workstreams. Advocate a user-informed approach to product development, ensuring user needs are at the forefront of our AI strategy.

  • Advocate for user centered product roadmaps influenced by user research.
  • Lead the research agenda for critical workstreams, taking into account product mission, team priorities, and a global user base.
  • Develop and provide leadership with a well-founded point of view, tell compelling user stories and have experience leveraging and using AI tools for efficient data processing and analysis.
  • Examine existing data and product designs to generate hypotheses and plans for high-impact research. Identify meaningful patterns and correlate signals to provide coherent research insights.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience in an applied Qualitative UX Research or a similar role.
  • Experience with research methods (e.g., usability, studies, contextual inquiries, 1:1 interviews, unmoderated research studies).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or related fields.
  • Experience with research methods (e.g., participatory research, conducting surveys, contextual inquiries, diary studies, unmoderated research studies).
  • Experience analyzing user behavior in B2B contexts, enterprise software, CRM platforms, or support tooling.
  • Expertise in utilizing AI technologies across the end-to-end research lifecycle from project scoping and study design to data analysis and reporting to drive efficiency and depth of insights.

This is the job

For our client, a global technology company focused on AI-driven industrial solutions, we are looking for a Senior Operations Research Engineer to join a team solving complex optimization problems at scale.

In this role, you will design mathematical models and optimization algorithms that improve planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and operational efficiency. Working closely with software engineers, data scientists, and machine learning specialists, you will turn complex business challenges into scalable optimization solutions suitable for production environments.

This position combines applied mathematics, optimization, simulation, and software engineering in a research-driven environment where ideas quickly become production systems.

This is you

  • Strong knowledge of optimization techniques such as linear programming, mixed-integer programming, constraint programming, nonlinear optimization, or heuristic/metaheuristic algorithms.

  • Experience translating business problems into mathematical optimization models.

  • Strong Python programming skills.

  • Experience building production-quality software rather than research prototypes only.

  • Experience working with large datasets and developing efficient optimization workflows.

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently in an R&D environment with evolving requirements.

  • Knowledge of high-performance computing (HPC).

  • Experience with cloud platforms and distributed computing.

This is your role

  • Design and implement mathematical optimization models for complex industrial problems.

  • Build scalable optimization pipelines using Python and modern software engineering practices.

  • Analyze algorithm performance and continuously improve solution quality and computational efficiency.
