title: Materialkemist/Materialingenjör
description:
Erasteel utvecklar och tillverkar höglegerade stål för krävande applikationer världen över. Våra stålsorter är tekniskt avancerade och ställer höga krav på kvalitet, analys och utveckling. Nu söker vi en Materialkemist/Materialingenjör till vår avdelning för Kvalitet och Laboratorium i Söderfors. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om tjänsten

I rollen får du en nyckelposition där du ansvarar för att utveckla och kvalitetssäkra analysmetoder, laboratorieutrustning och processer som är avgörande för vår verksamhet. Du blir en viktig del av ett kunnigt team och får möjlighet att arbeta både operativt och strategiskt i en verksamhet med högt tekniskt innehåll och starkt fokus på utveckling.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som Materialkemist/Materialingenjör kommer du att:

  • Ansvara för utveckling och kvalitetssäkring av kemiska och fysikaliska analysmetoder.
  • Arbeta med utrustning, underhåll, provtagning, provberedning, kalibrering och metodutveckling.
  • Säkerställa och utveckla analysmetoder inom bland annat: WDXRF, Spark-OES, Inert Gas Fusion IR/TC/MS av C, S, O, N, Ar
  • Driva investerings- och utvecklingsprojekt inom laboratorie- och analysutrustning.
  • Bidra till utvecklingen av laboratoriets IT-miljö och digitala verktyg för ökad kvalitet och effektivitet.
  • Arbeta med kvalitetssäkring av råmaterial och utveckling av nya stålsorter.
  • Delta i problemlösning och fungera som specialiststöd inom materialanalys.
  • Dokumentera arbetssätt, ta fram instruktioner och utbilda kollegor vid behov.
  • Bygga och utveckla externa kontaktnätverk för att följa den tekniska utvecklingen inom området.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är analytisk, driven och trivs med att kombinera teori och praktik. Du har ett genuint intresse för materialteknik, kemi och utvecklingsarbete och förmåga att självständigt driva flera aktiviteter parallellt. Du är strukturerad, noggrann och har ett stort tekniskt intresse med en problemlösande inställning. Du trivs med att växla mellan operativt och strategiskt arbete och har lätt för att samarbeta och dela med dig av din kunskap. Vidare är du van vid att dokumentera, utveckla arbetssätt och utbilda andra, och har ett starkt driv att kontinuerligt utveckla verksamheten.

Kvalifikationer

Krav

  • Högskoleutbildning inom kemi, materialteknik, fysik eller närliggande område (minst kandidatnivå).
  • Minst 5 års erfarenhet från kemiskt laboratoriearbete.
  • Goda kunskaper inom: Materialanalys, Kemi, Fysik.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
  • B-körkort.
  • Möjlighet att resa i tjänsten vid behov.

Meriterande

  • Civilingenjörs- eller doktorsexamen inom relevant område.
  • Erfarenhet från stål- eller metallindustrin.
  • Erfarenhet av provtagning och provberedning av råmaterial.
  • Erfarenhet av WDXRF, Spark-OES, masspektrometri, gaskromatografi och förbränningsanalys.
  • Kunskap inom SEM/EDX, partikelstorleksmätning och våtkemi.
  • Erfarenhet av laboratorie-IT och digitalisering.
  • Intresse för och erfarenhet av AI-baserade verktyg.
  • Kompetens inom radioaktivitetskontroll eller oförstörande provning.
  • Aktivt deltagande i tekniska nätverk och branschforum.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Erasteel får du möjlighet att arbeta i en internationell och teknikintensiv verksamhet där innovation, kvalitet och kompetensutveckling står i fokus.

Hos oss får du bland annat:

  • En nyckelroll i ett företag med världsledande produkter.
  • Stora möjligheter att påverka och utveckla laboratoriets framtida arbetssätt och teknik.
  • Deltaga i spännande investerings- och utvecklingsprojekt.
  • Kompetenta kollegor och ett starkt kunskapsutbyte.
  • Möjlighet att utveckla både ditt tekniska kunnande och ditt professionella nätverk.

Övrigt

Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta:

Tobias Jarmar

Kvalitetschef Erasteel

Tobias.jarmar@erasteel.com

Placeringsort: Söderfors

Omfattning: Heltid

Ansökan: Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Välkommen med din ansökan och bli en del av vår fortsatta utvecklingsresa!

Om arbetsgivaren - Erasteel

Erasteel är en global koncern som bedriver forskning & utveckling samt produktion och försäljning av gasatomiserade pulvermetallurgiska produkter och snabbstål med världen som marknad. Erasteel har flera hundra anställda och 5 industrianläggningar, varav 2 i Sverige, 2 i Frankrike och 1 i Kina. Bolaget är kvalitets- och miljöcertifierat.

För mer information om bolaget, besök www.erasteel.com

title: Tasker
description:
DHL Supply Chain is Hiring! At DHL, you will play a part in one of the world’s most essential industries. There has never been a better time to join DHL Supply Chain. In a global business like ours, the opportunities are endless. So, join us. Work with us. Grow with us.

The core responsibilities of this role include: Prioritizing, scheduling and planning tasks for assigned department.
Position: Tasker
Shift: Weekend day shift
Pay: $21.50 + $1.50 shift differential

In addition to the general job description below, the ideal candidate will also possess the following skills and/or experience:
Supply Chain, Wave Planner, Scheduler, Auditing, Product Compliance, Shipping, Receiving, Logistics, Coordinator, Lead, Transportation Clerk, Dispatch

A minimum of (1) one year's experience in the following:

-Prioritizing, scheduling and planning tasks for assigned department.

-Freight and Truck scheduling and planning for inbound and/or outbound shipments and maintaining accurate BOL’s (Bills of Lading).

-Coordinating tasks and schedules across all departments, including shipping, receiving, inbound and outbound freight.

-Experience using a commercial WMS (warehouse management system) such as Blue Yonder, Red Prairie, JDA, SAP, etc.

-Microsoft Office software, including Excel is required.

-This is a hands-on role that is spent most of shift out on the warehouse floor and moving to and from multiple areas of the building to include extended period of standing and walking.

Be part of the world’s largest logistics company!DHL Supply Chain hasbeen certified as a Great Place to Work® in the US and Canada! Our excellent benefits packages includes:
- Affordable medical, dental, and vision coverage available beginning on your 30thday
- PTO program for all associates, including paid holidays and vacation
- 401(k) with generous company match
- Tuition reimbursement program
- Excellent training and career advancement opportunities

Grow your skills. Shape your world.


Role Purpose:

The primary duty of this position is to expedite transactions through the warehouse management system. Taskers provide information and resolve issues with customers, carriers, and warehouse associates. The role may support the outbound, inbound or parcel functions.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Plan, allocate, pick, manifest, and close daily waves of orders.
  • Understand and utilize system screens to monitor and move workload through the system.
  • Work closely with operations to identify and eliminate overages, shorts and damages causing inventory issues.
  • Manage the scheduling of inbound carriers and the outbound shipping schedule by updating appropriate communication methods.
  • Generate and utilize system reports and audit sheets to evaluate the shift progress.
  • Communicate directly with the carrier(s) to insure seamless physical and systematic transactions.
  • Oversee exchange of parcel shipments from shipping dock to carrier’s truck.
  • Resolve data transmission failures/errors with customer’s IT and procurement teams.
  • Interface with IT contacts in event of system-related barriers.
  • Insure complete communication for turn of shift.

Required Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Six months warehouse experience, preferred
  • 0-1 years experience in data entry and/or dispatch, preferred
  • Basic understanding and application of Microsoft Excel, preferred

Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Engineer - Solar
description:
WSP South Africa is seeking an experienced and passionate Contracts Engineer / Senior Engineer – Renewable Energy to serve as a technical consultant for utility-scale Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), and Wind Energy projects across Africa, while also supporting international renewable energy assignments as required.

The successful candidate will lead and support renewable energy advisory, technical due diligence, asset performance management, and techno-commercial evaluation activities for utility-scale Solar PV, BESS, and wind projects. The role encompasses conducting technical and commercial risk assessments, supporting investment and acquisition decisions, optimizing portfolio performance, managing stakeholder and contractual interfaces, and ensuring compliance with performance guarantees and project obligations. The candidate will be expected to provide independent technical advice throughout the project lifecycle, delivering operational and commercial value to clients, investors, lenders, and project developers. The position will require periodic international travel, with a particular focus on projects located across Africa.

Technical (Approximately 100%):

  • Managing high-quality technical advisory works.

  • Project management and interfacing between engineering disciplines (mechanical, electrical, civil and control & instrumentation);

  • Provide technical input from initial assessment through to technical and economic feasibility of the solar PV /Wind projects and integration with other electrical or generating plants as necessary.

  • Review overall project design and suggest technical and design improvements.

  • Preparation and management of technical specifications, bills of materials, tender stage management and evaluations, negotiation and selection of Balance of Plant, Operation & Maintenance or EPC, and other supply contracts.

  • Technical reviews/negotiate key construction contracts for, and alongside, clients.

  • Due diligence of solar PV projects and support Sponsor(s) and Lender(s) throughout the Financial Close process including technical liaison with legal and financial advisors.

  • Assessing technical risks and proposing mitigation strategies to reduce risk exposure in project CAPEX, OPEX, and revenues.

  • Assist with and/or conduct any other necessary aspects of a project that fall within the discipline of the role.

  • Support technical advisory, due diligence, and techno-commercial consulting activities for utility-scale Solar PV, BESS, and Wind Energy projects.

  • Conduct technical, operational, contractual, and commercial risk assessments throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Perform technical due diligence and feasibility evaluations to support project acquisitions, financing, investments, and business development opportunities.

  • Provide asset performance analysis, benchmarking, and optimization recommendations to maximize portfolio value and operational efficiency.

  • Review and assess project designs, energy yield studies, EPC/O&M contracts, performance guarantees, and acceptance testing requirements.

  • Support lenders, investors, developers, and asset owners by delivering independent technical advice and risk-based recommendations.

  • Monitor portfolio performance and develop actionable strategies to improve plant reliability, availability, and financial returns.

  • Lead root cause investigations and performance improvement initiatives across operating renewable energy assets.

  • Review technical stakeholder interfaces, including clients, developers, EPC contractors, OEMs, lenders, and investors.

  • Support contract negotiations, project execution reviews, and compliance with technical and contractual obligations.

  • Prepare technical reports, due diligence assessments, presentations, and advisory deliverables for clients and project stakeholders.

  • Contribute to business development activities, proposal preparation, market assessments, and the growth of WSP's renewable energy advisory services.

  • Support multidisciplinary project teams and provide technical input across local and international renewable energy projects.

  • Undertake travel within Africa and internationally, as required, to support project execution, site visits, technical reviews, and client engagements.

Health and Safety

  • Role model standards for SHEQ performance and behavior consistent with the company’s health, safety, environmental, and quality vision and policies by influencing those around you

  • Contributing to the identification of SHEQ risks and driving processes to achieve Zero Harm

  • Embracing, displaying, and promoting the company values and ensuring a safe working environment is maintained at all times

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • B.Eng or BTech Engineering (Preference EEE, ECE/Mech)

  • 4-8 years experience in Renewable energy, solar PV and wind experience is considered very advantageous. A Mix of South African experience (REIPPP) and regional overseas experience is also preferred.

  • In-depth knowledge and field expertise regarding solar PV/BESS/Wind turbine technologies including emerging technologies in the international renewable energy market.

  • Renewable Energy contracts exposure (i.e EPC, PPA, O&M, and TSIA etc)

  • Exposure to contractor management approach

  • Technical advisory experience towards investors, project developers, and banks.

  • Proven experience in business development.

  • Knowledge of various solar PV applications (utility-scale, ground-mounted, building-mounted, fixed tilt, single-axis, and multi-axis tracking).

  • Knowledge of various BESS and Wind applications

  • International solar PV project development and delivery experience.

  • Experience covering a range of solar PV plant lifecycle delivery (including feasibility and development engineering, construction monitoring, witnessing testing and commissioning activities, and operational monitoring/inspections)

  • Knowledge of solar PV plant designs, Energy Yield Assessment, layouts, and connection interfaces.

  1. ECSA registration or country equivalent.

Key Areas of Expertise

  • Renewable Energy Advisory

  • Technical Due Diligence

  • Solar PV, BESS & Wind Energy

  • Asset Performance Management

  • Techno-Commercial Evaluation

  • Portfolio Optimization

  • Risk Assessment & Mitigation

  • Contract & Stakeholder Management

  • Performance Guarantees & Acceptance Testing

  • Investment and Acquisition Support

  • Reliability Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Business Development & Client Advisory

KEY COMPETENCIES AND GENERIC SKILLS:

  • Minimum 4-8 years of postgraduate experience, preferably in the renewable industry.
  • Ability to work within a team of engineers.
  • Good communication skills
  • Good technical report writing skills
  • Ability to manage time, quality and effort in order to deliver a quality product within time and cost constraints.
  • Ability to coordinate and manage projects
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Must be able to function independently

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Project Director - Enabling Works and Utilities
description:
For Universal ​United Kingdom Resort ​(UUKR), Responsible for providing leadership to a diverse multi-departmental team for the planning, design, construction, and commissioning of infrastructure and property development requirements to support the new park and associated destination experiences, more fully defined as the Entertainment Resort Complex (ERC). The Project Director will be responsible for directing and managing all aspects of the enabling works, inclusive of utilities, to create a world-class destination resort, including all planning, budgeting, commercial, scheduling, strategy, design, construction, delivery, stakeholder engagement, delivery, and commissioning required to complete the project within the assigned budget, quality, schedule, safety, creative and guest experience targets.

The Project Director shall control works to avoid contract claims and disputes; minimise change orders during construction phases; effectively manage changes in the project; eliminate interface disruptions between project participants; maintain, and where possible improve the project schedule and budget; ensure quality design and construction work; emphasise “hands-on” management of field operations; establish and maintain competent and experienced team members and consultant/contractor teams; implement efficient and timely document control.

Major Responsibilities

  • Work with Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) leadership and provide direction to multi-departmental project teams (Universal Creative, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Legal, External Affairs, Security, EHS, etc.) to establish scope and schedule requirements, develop budgets and financial planning, manage procurement, address SDO conditions and governmental commitments, and complete design, construction and commissioning.
  • Manage the planning and execution of enabling infrastructure and non-park developments, such as mass grading, water management, environmental mitigation, utility supplies, a central energy plant, process water facility, rainwater harvesting system, as well as potentially back of house facilities. Work with statutory undertakers to align their works in accordance to Universal schedule, budget and contractor phasing.
  • Ensure that all project procedures are being followed as it relates to correspondence, RFI’s, directives, design and construction drawings, submittals, meeting minutes, action trackers, default lists, notices, pay applications, etc. necessary to successfully complete works to enable theme park and resort construction.
  • Responsible for maintaining the overall project budget and schedule within the targeted objectives set forth during project approval.
  • Provide leadership and personal development guidance to all direct reports to support growth within current positions and opportunities for additional growth and advancement within UDX.
  • Responsible for the management, tracking and reporting of all the necessary project components inclusive of budget, schedule and progress of the project to upper management. Responsible to maintain accurate documentation necessary to ensure a successful project completion within the targeted budget and schedule.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established Universal policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Bachelors Degree or equivalent qualifications in Engineering, Construction, Management or a related field is required.
  • SIA licensing and/or relevant executive security certifications preferred.
  • Experience in construction project management, including project management, engineering, construction or commercial facilities industry.
  • Experience in the delivery of infrastructure construction projects design and construction phases.
  • Experience in project scheduling, estimating, bidding process and negotiations.
  • Strong knowledge of construction projects delivery methods, specifically enabling infrastructure, i.e. mass grading, water management and environmental mitigation; and utilities.
  • Experience working with utility statutory undertakers in the UK. Experience in interpretation and understanding of design and construction drawings.
  • Experience in scheduling, estimating, critical path, site logistics, constructability, and contracts.
  • Knowledge and experience of construction and project management processes.
  • Knowledge and experience with construction finances including budgets, cash flow, and change orders.
  • The Project Director will be required to direct the coordination between multiple Universal stakeholders, vendors and contractor’s; therefore, good communications skills are required.
  • Emphasis on “hands on” management of field operations; maintain operational use of completed facilities during construction; implement efficient and timely document control.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Project, Planner, Power BI, Teams, Power Apps.
  • Bluebeam or equivalent Portable Document Format (PDF) software. AutoCAD and Revit preferred.
  • Role may require regular travel across the UK, with occasional international travel.

title: Sr. Engineer Cloud Security
description:
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Engineer Cloud Security to support and execute day-to-day cloud security operations across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This role is responsible for operational cloud security monitoring, misconfiguration management, and compliance validation, working closely with Cloud Security Engineers, Network Security, and application teams.

The Senior Engineer Cloud Security applies hands-on technical skills to identify, analyze, and remediate cloud security risks while ensuring alignment with enterprise security standards, Zero Trust principles, and regulatory requirements. This role mirrors the operational depth and accountability of senior engineering roles while maintaining a strong Engineer-focused execution model.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Perform continuous security monitoring and operational reviews of cloud environments across GCP (primary), AWS, Azure, and OCI.
  • Analyze and triage findings from cloud security tools such as GCP Security Command Center (SCC), AWS Security Hub, Azure Defender, and OCI Cloud Guard.
  • Own remediation tracking, validation, and closure of cloud security findings in collaboration with application owners and DevOps teams.
  • Support implementation and validation of cloud security controls including IAM, network security, encryption, logging, and monitoring.
  • Participate in cloud architecture and design reviews to ensure security-by-design and Zero Trust principles are applied.
  • Support compliance activities aligned with CIS benchmarks, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and internal security standards.
  • Maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and runbooks for cloud security processes.
  • Assist in audit evidence collection, reporting, and remediation validation for internal and external audits.
  • Contribute to cloud security dashboards, metrics, and reporting for operational and leadership visibility.
  • Support development and enhancement of automation and scripting for cloud security baselines and controls.
  • Collaborate with Network Security, IAM, and Application Security teams to ensure consistent security posture across hybrid environments.
  • Participate in security incidents related to cloud platforms, including investigation, containment, and post-incident documentation.
  • Continuously monitor emerging cloud threats, service changes, and best practices to improve security controls.
  • Additional duties may be assigned as necessary to meet organizational needs.

Skills and Qualifications

Required:

  • 5-10 years of experience in cloud, DevOps, or security operations roles.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure), with GCP preferred.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security services and controls including IAM, networking, encryption, and logging.
  • Experience analyzing findings from CSPM and native cloud security tools.
  • Basic experience with infrastructure-as-code concepts and cloud automation.
  • Familiarity with scripting or automation using tools such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Understanding security frameworks and standards such as CIS, NIST CSF, and ISO 27001.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, DevOps, and security teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Cloud certifications such as Google Associate Cloud Engineer, AWS Associate, or Azure Associate.
  • Experience supporting compliance and audit activities in cloud environments.
  • Exposure to Zero Trust, security-by-design, and cloud-native security architectures.
  • Experience building or supporting cloud security automation and reporting pipelines.

Shift Timing:

Work hours may vary, and the position may require availability during off-business hours as dictated by project needs, system changes, or security events

What We’re Looking For:

  • Demonstrated a growth mindset by staying curious and continuously learning, embracing challenges, and improving themselves.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

  • We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
  • We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
  • We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Our Approach to Flexible Work:
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

Who We Are:

title: Senior Scene Generation Engineer
description:
Senior Scene Generation Engineer

Location: Huntsville, AL

Job Description

Worker Type

Regular


Job Description

The Engineering Services Division is searching for a Scene Generation Engineer towards the design, development, and validation of high-fidelity physics-based 3D radiometric synthetic environments across a full range of environments encompassing tactical, strategic and surveillance scenarios. description:

Job Description

At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. Job Title:

Senior AI Automation Engineer

Company:

Prologis

A day in the life

The Senior AI Automation Engineer accelerates the delivery and adoption of practical AI solutions across Digital Experience Technology and adjacent operational teams. This role partners with stakeholders supporting public websites, authenticated portals, service operations, managed service providers, marketing technology, digital platforms, and vendor management to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into production capabilities. The engineer leads work from discovery and prototyping through deployment, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement. By establishing reusable engineering patterns, governance practices, and enterprise AI assets, this role helps improve customer and employee experiences while reducing manual effort and operational constraints.

Key responsibilities include:

· Design and deliver AI-powered applications, agents, copilots, task assistants, and workflow automations that improve digital product delivery, customer self-service, support operations, knowledge retrieval, vendor management, and internal productivity.

· Integrate AI services with customer portals, custom applications, workflow and service management platforms, knowledge and analytics systems, procurement and contract lifecycle processes, and AWS services.

· Lead AI solutions from business discovery and rapid prototyping through production deployment, adoption, performance measurement, and continuous improvement.

· Translate business needs into scalable technical designs in partnership with Digital Experience, Customer Experience, Service Operations, Product, Platform Engineering, Vendor Management, and other stakeholders.

· Define reusable engineering patterns for prompt frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, text-to-SQL, semantic data models, agent workflows, evaluation, guardrails, human review, and workflow orchestration.

· Build secure, reliable, observable, and cost-effective AI applications using modern software engineering practices, APIs, Model Context Protocol, agent-to-agent services, cloud services, automation frameworks, and enterprise integration patterns.

· Measure solution value through automation rate, adoption, accuracy, customer satisfaction, productivity improvement, operational savings, and return on investment, while mentoring engineers, contractors, and implementation partners.

Building blocks for success

Required:

· 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, automation engineering, digital technology, data and analytics, or a related technical field.

· Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, copilots, or workflow automation solutions.

· Experience applying generative AI, large language models, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and agent workflows to business problems.

· Programming experience with Python and Node.js for APIs, automations, AI applications, Model Context Protocol servers, agent-to-agent services, and integrations.

· Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs, JSON, webhooks, authentication, event-driven workflows, and secure data exchange.

· Experience with Dataiku, Snowflake, AWS, or comparable enterprise data and AI platforms.

· Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, containers, DevOps practices, or scalable cloud deployment patterns.

· Experience implementing testing, evaluation, monitoring, and feedback loops for AI applications, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, or agent workflows.

· Ability to independently lead technical delivery and communicate AI solutions in clear business terms to technology and operational stakeholders.

Preferred:

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

· Experience supporting customer-facing digital platforms, authenticated portals, customer self-service, or service operations workflows.

· Experience with enterprise platforms such as CRM, Drupal CMS, digital asset management, service management, marketing technology, knowledge management, contract management, or procurement systems.

· Experience designing reusable AI reference architectures, accelerators, prompt libraries, multi-agent workflows, tool-using agents, context engineering, agent memory, and human-in-the-loop processes.

· Experience working with distributed engineering teams, vendors, contractors, or implementation partners, including defining metrics for adoption, productivity, customer experience, operational savings, and return on investment.

· Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

description:
Senior Data Engineer

Location: Athens

Department: Product Development

Our Sportsbook Data Team is looking for a Data Engineer to make a difference in the further development of our Data Warehouse solutions, designing and developing our Sportsbook data platform to cover both internal and external business needs. We have a world-class Sportsbook, developed in-house by our dedicated Sportsbook tech team and growing at a very rapid rate, expanding not only in new markets but also as a B2B product. Having our product available in different parts of the world and offering sports all around the world requires to have support around the clock. Our Product Development organisation is truly Global with cross functional teams spanning 5 Tech Hubs. These can be found in Malta, Budapest, Stockholm, Tallinn and Athens.

The Wow

Our Sportsbook Platform is ours – from our Architecture to our Trading teams – we have an in-house platform which hosts our brands offering Sportsbetting for our customers. From the tools our traders use to the cutting edge features our customers use to bet on various sports – our teams are the backbone to making this happen! Our aim is to create the best performance, functionality and user experience in the iGaming industry! As part of our Sportsbook tech team – a high performance, throughout and availability product serving many brands (20+), you will be key in ensuring that the team delivers the required business value.

A taster of what you will be involved with:

  • Maintaining and evolving our Data Structures
  • Build new ETL flows and maintain/improve existing ones
  • Be part of designing new data structures and data modelling concepts
  • Ensure data quality by verifying data consistency and accuracy – being able to create data validation methods
  • Write, optimize, and maintain stored procedures
  • Investigate, assess, and develop message-based architectures for data streams
  • Comfortable working under Agile Framework (Scrum 2-week iterations)
  • Have an investigative mindset to be able to troubleshoot – being creative when it comes to troubleshooting problems and incident management
  • Document necessary processes and procedures (creating KBs, runbooks, topology etc)
  • Taking full ownership of projects and tasks with being able to work within the team
  • Work closely with stakeholders to deliver accurate and timely insights to our business partners

What we are looking for

  • Advanced T-SQL Coding is a must
  • Relational and non-relational DBs (proven experience in MSSQL 2014 – 2017)
  • Familiar with ETL process (SSIS)
  • Familiar with DWH and ETL concepts
  • Familiar with Data Modelling concepts
  • Familiar with Reporting and Analytical Tools (SSRS/SSAS)
  • Familiar with software versioning tools like Git
  • Be experienced and knowledgeable in core database development tuning techniques
  • Automation and scripting will be a plus
  • Additional programming skills will be a plus (.NET, Python, R, Scala)
  • Knowledge around Big Data concepts and data streaming architectures will be a plus
  • Continuous learning mindset
  • Can effectively prioritize and handle multiple tasks and projects
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills

What we offer

  • Monthly Allowance for Lunch
  • Private & Life Plan Insurance for you and your family
  • Team Building Budget
  • Annual Wellness Allowance
  • Corporate Travel Insurance
  • Events and initiatives both Local (Quarterly Meetings) and Global
  • Professional Development Programs & Internal Career Opportunities
  • Milestone Birthday

title: Remote Senior Backend Engineer (Canada)
description:
Loot Labs is on a mission to make collecting fun. We believe that every collectible tells a story: of passion, nostalgia, and discovery.
Through our flagship product, Boxed.Gg we are reimagining how the world collects by blending digital entertainment with tangible rewards, delivering nostalgia and discovery straight to the fans' doorsteps.
We are...

  • Community First: We've served 500k collectors and foster an active community of over 125k+ Discord members.

  • Ambitiously Led: Led by veterans from Microsoft, Twitch, 2K, and Boeing.

  • Remote-First: We value high autonomy, low ego, and trust our team to build from anywhere in the world.

Since our inception in 2023, we’ve seen significant year-over-year growth. And now we're gearing up for our most ambitious year yet, with major expansions planned across product offerings, strategic partnerships, and next-generation collector experiences. If you’re ready to build products that spark joy at a global scale, you’re in the right place.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and scale the systems behind our products. You’ll lead architecture discussions, ship secure and performant APIs, and collaborate closely across the stack. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just write code, but owns the full system lifecycle from design to debugging to iteration.
Location: Remote (North America Preferred) Occasional U.S. travel is required for in-person collaboration, team offsites, and company events.

Type: Full-time

Time Zone Requirement: Must have 5+ hours of overlap with US Pacific Time (9am–6pm PT)

Language: Must be fluent in English and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • You’ll own features end-to-end and see your impact in days, not months.

  • Work alongside people who ship fast and care about the details.

  • Take ownership in ambiguous situations and shape solutions collaboratively.

How You’ll Contribute & Succeed Here

  • Bring senior-level experience building production backend systems (typically 5+ years)

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable backend services using AWS (DynamoDB, Lambda, S3, AppSync, Cognito, SQS) and SST (v2 and v3), with Infrastructure as Code best practices.

  • Develop and maintain GraphQL APIs and application logic in TypeScript

  • Lead system design, data modeling, and architectural decisions for scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability, owning solutions from planning through launch and iteration

  • Implement robust security, authentication/authorization, and data protection

  • Maintain healthy production systems through CI/CD best practices, robust observability, and effective incident response

  • Collaborate with frontend, product, and design to deliver backend systems that enable seamless user experiences

  • Bring strong product sense and user empathy. Always build with the why in mind, not just the what

  • Proactively communicate, raise concerns early, and solve problems with teammates

  • Balance speed and robustness, making pragmatic trade-offs to deliver value quickly without sacrificing quality

  • Mentor others, share knowledge, and help raise the technical bar

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with e-commerce systems, including payment processing, marketplaces, and order/fulfillment workflows

  • Familiarity with blockchain, cryptocurrency, or digital collectibles

  • Experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch

  • Experience building internal tools (e.G., Retool)

  • Experience with real-time and event-driven systems

  • Experience with data scraping or browser automation

  • Interest in collectibles, gaming, or creator platforms

Working Hours & Compensation

Loot Labs is a remote-first company, and this role is open to candidates globally. To support efficient collaboration across teams, we will prioritize applicants who have working hour overlap with U.S. and E.U. time zones.

Compensation will be competitive and based on your experience level as well as local market benchmarks for your region.

Accessibility & Employment Eligibility

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to support you.

For candidates located in the United States: Loot Labs participates in E-Verify and will confirm work authorization as part of the hiring process.

title: Communication and Events Apprentice
description:
Job title: Communication and Events Apprentice

Department: Marketing & Communication

Reports to: Marketing & Communications Director

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Apprenticeship of 24 months (contrat d’apprentissage)

Starting date: ASAP 2026

PUR Description

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects.

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries.

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods.

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action.

About the role

PUR is looking for a Communication & Events Manager apprentice to support the Marketing & Communications team in bringing PUR’s story, expertise and impact to life across events, content and sales enablement.

This is a hands-on role combining strategy and execution, offering strong exposure to international B2B marketing, sustainability, event management, and content development.

You will help increase PUR’s visibility and impact at key climate and sustainability events, while contributing to high-quality content for clients, partners, and internal teams.

The role requires strong project management skills, excellent English, curiosity and rigor, and the ability to work with diverse stakeholders across the organization.

You will have real responsibility and autonomy, with close support and mentoring from the Director.

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to:

Events management

  • Support the definition and execution of PUR’s annual events strategy and calendar.

  • Help maximize PUR’s presence and impact on key industry, climate, and nature events.

  • Coordinate event participation (objectives, attendees, success metrics).

  • Support the organization of client events, roundtables, field visits and webinars.

  • Manage event logistics (venues, invitations, speakers, agendas, suppliers, budgets).

  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure events drive business and relationship objectives.

  • Track budget, performance, and post-event insights.

Content & communications management

  • Support the execution of PUR’s social media and editorial calendar (LinkedIn focus).

  • Draft and publish content aligned with PUR’s positioning and tone of voice.

  • Contribute to thought leadership content (articles, case studies, webinars, newsletters).

  • Coordinate content development with internal experts and external partners.

  • Translate complex technical topics into clear, engaging content.

  • Support the development of commercial and client-facing materials.

  • Monitor market trends and content performance.

We are looking for someone with:

  • Enrolled in a master's degree in marketing, communication, events, or similar.

  • Strong interest or first experience in communications, content, events or marketing

  • Good project management and multitasking skills

  • Excellent writing and synthesis abilities

  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with diverse stakeholders

  • Proactive, curious and eager to learn, especially on sustainability topics

  • Organized, detail-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Fluent in English (French is a plus)

We are looking for someone who wants to be trusted with real responsibility, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to learn through close collaboration and mentoring.

Recruitment Process:

  1. First interview with HR

  2. Case study interview with the Marketing & Communications Director

  3. Reference check and offer

At PUR, we strive to build inclusive teams and an equitable workplace where our employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. As a global company operating across six continents, we recognize that diversity in the workplace is essential to achieving our mission.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.

PUR is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment. If you require accommodation or consideration throughout the interview process, let us know, and we will do our best to support you.

title: Sesonkityöntekijöitä pakettien lajittelutehtäviin, Vantaa
description:
Jäikö opiskelupaikka tällä kertaa saamatta? Sopiiko keikkaluontoinen työ vauhdikkaassa terminaaliympäristössä sinun elämäntilanteeseen? Oletko reipas, tarkka ja työtä pelkäämätön henkilö, jolta löytyy jo hieman kokemusta logistiikka-alalta? Mikäli nyökyttelet, niin jatka lukemista – saatamme etsiä juuri sinua!

Haemme asiakkaallemme Vantaan Hakkilaan TERMINAALITYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ loppuvuoden sesonkiin. Tämä sesonkityö sopii parhaiten sellaiselle henkilölle, joka pystyy tarvittaessa tekemään täydet viikkotunnit, mutta talous ei kaadu, mikäli joinakin viikkoina vuoroja on vähemmän.

Tehtävän kuvaus

Terminaalin pääasialliset työtehtävät on pakettien lemppaus ja lajittelu sormiskanneria apuna käyttäen. Kokemus erilaisista trukeista, sähköpässeistä tai vastaavista lavojen siirtotyökaluista katsotaan eduksi, ja mahdollistaa nopeamman siirtymisen monipuolisempiin tehtäviin.

Terminaalissa työpäivät on hektisiä ja työtahti ripeä, joten työ vaatii tekijältään huolellista ja tehokasta työskentelyotetta. Terminaalin työ on myös fyysisesti hyvin raskasta ja askelia saattaa päivän aikana tulla jopa 25-30 tuhatta.

Tarjoamme

Me Visiolla pidämme huolta siitä, että varustuksesi on kunnossa, saat työhön kattavan perehdytyksen ja kaikki työsuhdeasiat hoidetaan vastuullisesti. Terminaalissa on käytössä Huolinta-alan varastoterminaali- ja satamatyöntekijöitä koskeva työehtosopimus, jonka mukaisesti palkkaus alk. 17,22€/h + TES:n mukaiset lisät. Visiolaisena saat palkan kaksi kertaa kuussa.
Sopimus on 0-tuntinen, mutta haemme ensisijaisesti sellaisia henkilöitä, jotka ovat valmiita tekemään mahdollisimman paljon töitä etenkin kiireisimmässä sesonkirytinässä marras-joulukuussa. Tarpeen/tarjonnan kohdatessa hyvällä tekijällä on myös mahdollisuus jatkaa työskentelyä sesongin jälkeen keikkaluontoisesti – omien sekä asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan. Työtä on mahdollisuus tehdä aamu-, ilta- tai yövuorossa – toiveidesi mukaan!

Edellytämme

  • Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa sekä aikaisempaa kokemusta logistiikka-alalta (etenkin terminaalityöstä)
  • Sujuvaa suomen kielen osaamista ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
  • Oma-aloitteisuutta ja tehokkaaseen tekemiseen pyrkivää suhtautumista työntekoon
  • Reipasta ja positiivista asennetta

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? – Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme henkilö, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus! Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta. Paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä ja työt alkaa sopimuksen mukaan syys-lokakuun aikana.

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

  • liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta
  • kerrot hakumotiivistasi, käytettävyydestäsi sekä valmiuksistasi pärjätä juuri tässä tehtävässä

Hakemuksia tulee tehtävään runsaasti, joten emme valitettavasti voi huomioida sellaisia hakemuksia, joissa ei ilmene lainkaan aikaisempaa työkokemusta.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, niin voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaavalle henkilölle, Henna Kivakka, sähköpostia osoitteeseen henna.kivakka(at)visiohr.fi. Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka pelaa reilua peliä. Tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Työntekijöitä autamme löytämään oman visionsa mukaisen työpaikan. Työnantajia taas palvelemme etsimällä oikeat ihmiset avoimiin tehtäviin.

Yhteistyö perustuu jokaisen kolmen tahon kesken vallitsevaan luottamukseen. Mikäli haluat työnantajan, jolle jokainen työntekijä on merkityksellinen ja arvokas, niin se on Visio!

We're working on building an amazing culture at Feathr, where amazing people (like you) can do their best work. If you're ready to grow and "help the helpers" you've come to the right place.

Principal Frontend Engineer

Compensation Range: $145,000 - $165,000 base + up to 12% bonus potential
Benefits: Fully remote, Health/dental/vision insurance, Company Holidays + Winter Break, Paid vacation + sick time off

Your Work:

Feathr’s Marketing SaaS platform is critical to the value we deliver to our clients. Feathr’s Principal Engineers help us grow and maintain the technical components that allow us to meet our diverse customer base's advertising, marketing, and web analytics needs. A Principal Engineer at Feathr has a demonstrated interest and proficiency in web development.

You will work under the direction of the Associate Director of Product Engineering on frontend software development projects. Engineers at Feathr own their code from planning to maintenance to retirement - you will work with internal and external stakeholders to develop requirements and design technical solutions, collaborate with your engineering colleagues to implement those solutions, deploy and monitor your changes in production, and address issues as they are identified.

Your Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on SaaS products.

  • Expertise in designing, building, and maintaining large-scale distributed systems.

  • Professional experience owning a process that included shipping a complicated piece of software to real users.

Your Technical Skills:

  • Expertise with React and TypeScript.

  • Demonstrated focus on developing and maintaining security and compliance with enterprise data concerns.

  • Experience in writing automated unit tests for your code.

  • Planning and executing an integration with an API layer.

  • Knowledge of REST/CRUD API development.

  • Ability to maintain and scale containerized applications.

  • Ability to optimize data modeling for constantly growing business needs.

  • Experience with self-hosted Drone CI/CD.

  • Not required but a big plus - experience with Storybook for component development and documentation.

Your Qualities:

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for all aspects of web development.

  • Service-oriented team player who is here to achieve success for Feathr as well as themselves.

  • Pragmatic and customer-oriented. You are building software to help customers, not for the sake of building software.

  • Comfortable adapting to quickly changing conditions. You might be working on one project but need to context switch to another unexpectedly during a critical outage.

  • Careful, detail-oriented approach to building software - ask questions first and write code later.

  • Comfortable breaking down technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Your code solves immediate problems while building a sustainable system that lasts into the future.

  • Understand how to ingest and transform event streams from a variety of sources.

Your Day:

  • Assist with the mentoring and training of developers.

  • Review and approve code written by colleagues.

  • Solve technical problems and document their solutions.

  • Plan and iterate over the product development lifecycle.

  • Work alongside other Product Team engineers to design and develop features.

  • Collaborate closely with designers to implement and refine frontend UI/UX.

  • Break down complex technical challenges into manageable work components, ensuring clear deliverables.

  • Receive feedback on your code and features and iterate.

  • Collaborate with members of other departments to ensure technical solutions meet the company's business interests.

  • Ensure the integrity, availability, and confidentiality of Feathr’s data and operations.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation:

Starting salary for this position is $145,000 annually depending on experience and credentials, with the potential to earn an additional 12% of base salary.

Location:

This position is remote for candidates located within the United States, with preference given to those who reside in the Eastern or Central time zones. There is also an option to work from our headquarters in Gainesville, FL. If you aren’t familiar, Gainesville is a hip, mid-sized city with a highly innovative population and an attainable standard of living.

Interview Process:

As a part of our commitment to creating a fair, equitable, and positive interview experience for all candidates, we offer full transparency of our interview stages to give applicants an idea of the time and effort involved. Additionally, each interview stage consists of standardized questions and rubrics with a scoring system to ensure a consistent and fair assessment practice of all candidates.

  • HR Information Screen - The Talent Acquisition Team will invite candidates that move forward to a 20-30 minute virtual interview. This conversation will be focused on relevant work experience, compensation, role overview, and answering any questions the candidate has.

  • Hiring Manager Interview- 45 minute virtual meeting with the Director of Engineering to answer role-specific questions and dive deeper into your background and technical experience.

  • Work Assignment - Candidates will be given a work assignment prompt to complete a project that is relevant to the work they can expect in the role. You are given ample amount of time to complete this project before turning in.

  • Panel Interview - 1 hour interview with two to three key members of the team. This interview will dive deeper into the role, technical knowledge, and requirements of the position. You will also utilize this time to review any questions related to your work assignment.

  • Offer - The Talent Acquisition Team will reach out with the details of the offer to discuss with the candidate.

Interviewing at Feathr

We've prepared a comprehensive candidate resource that provides valuable insights and tips for interviewing at Feathr. It covers everything from common interview questions to helpful advice on how to make the most of your interview experience with us. Access the resource here.

We encourage all applicants to take advantage of this resource to help prepare for their interviews and gain a deeper understanding of what to expect when applying to join our Flock.

Benefits & Perks for full-time employees

We love our Flock and the work they do! But let’s be honest, life isn’t just about work. So we created a perks and benefits package that aims to help our team grow by including their wellness, families, passions, and personal time.

  • Fully remote

  • Full vision, dental, and ~99% health insurance for employees

  • Sick time off

  • Vacation time off

  • Extended Wintr Break

  • Parental Leave

  • Wellness Reimbursement Credit

  • Home Office Stipend

  • Professional Development Budget

  • Team hangouts and events

Culture:

Feathr defines culture as the secret sauce that makes our flock members want to come to work everyday and do their best work. Like every company, we have an acronym that conveys the most important aspects of the culture we strive to have.

  • Practicality: Progress Over Perfection

  • Ambition: When Feathr wins, We all win

  • Candor: Better communication, Better results

  • Trust: Assume the best, Share openly

  • Service: We exist to fix

This acronym is only as useful as the integrity of the people who reference it and believe in it. Every person at Feathr will face challenges, the most important quality is a commitment to work through those challenges with self-awareness and honesty.

Feathr is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, if you think you’d drive value in this position, please apply.

title: Remote Senior Software Engineer - Backend
description:
Senior Software Engineer – Backend



  • Location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA strongly preferred - hybrid from our San Ramon office (3 days a week);
    Core hours 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM PT.

  • Compensation: The US base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 – $180,000 + up to 15% performance-based bonus. The position is eligible for performance-based equity compensation.

  • Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.


About ARIVE


ARIVE (arive.Com) is the industry's first integrated LOS, POS, and Pricing Engine with a connected Lender Marketplace, purpose-built for independent mortgage originators. We are a dynamic high-growth company revolutionizing digital mortgage originations, and our platform seamlessly connects independent loan originators, top-tier wholesale lenders, borrowers, referral partners, credit providers, and property and settlement service providers — creating a faster, more transparent, and more affordable path to homeownership.


Position Overview


We're seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer to design, support, and scale the services at the heart of the ARIVE platform — the engine powering loan originations for thousands of independent mortgage brokers nationwide. You'll work hands-on with Node.Js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, and Docker, partnering closely with product, frontend, and DevOps teams to ship high-quality, cloud-native features at startup speed.


A key part of this role is production ownership — partnering with our support team to troubleshoot at-scale production issues, driving root cause to resolution, and hardening the platform so problems stay fixed. You'll also coordinate closely with our US architects and India-based engineering team for new features. This is a high-ownership role for an engineer who loves solving hard distributed-systems and data problems in a domain where reliability, performance, and security truly matter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of major workstreams alongside our most senior architects — freeing them to focus on next-generation platform initiatives. Join us and make a meaningful, sustainable impact alongside some of the industry's brightest minds.


Key Responsibilities



  • Design & Build: Architect, develop, and maintain scalable RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.Js and TypeScript, powering mission-critical loan origination workflows.

  • Data Engineering: Design efficient database schemas and optimize queries and migrations across PostgreSQL and MongoDB;
    implement caching strategies (e.G., Redis) for high-throughput workloads.

  • Cloud & Containers: Build, test, and deploy containerized applications with Docker;
    deploy and operate services on AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS).

  • DevOps Collaboration: Partner with DevOps to strengthen CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).

  • Reliability & Security: Champion system reliability, performance, and secure coding best practices — our platform handles sensitive borrower data, and we operate in a SOC 2 Type II environment where security is a first-class engineering concern.

  • Production Ownership: Partner with our Support team as an engineering point of contact for escalated production issues at scale — triage, root-cause, and resolve end-to-end, then land the permanent fix, alerting, and runbooks so issues don’t recur. Drive performance optimization across the backend and data layers.

  • Global Collaboration: Coordinate daily with our India-based engineering team — handoffs, code reviews, and design alignment — keeping core hours of 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM PT to maximize morning overlap.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead technical design sessions and code reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and contribute to product planning and architectural roadmaps.


Things We Look For



  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience with most, if not all, of the following: Node.Js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, and Docker.

  • API & Systems Design: Strong command of RESTful API design, microservices and event-driven architectures, and message queues (e.G., SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Data Fluency: Deep experience with both relational and NoSQL data modeling, query optimization, indexing strategies, and zero-downtime migrations.

  • Quality Mindset: Solid habits around automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), code review, and CI/CD;
    you ship fast without breaking things.

  • Security Awareness: Working knowledge of secure SDLC practices — authN/authZ patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), OWASP Top 10, and handling sensitive data in a regulated environment.

  • Observability: Experience with monitoring and APM tooling (e.G., Datadog, CloudWatch, New Relic) and a bias toward measuring before optimizing.

  • Escalation Experience: You’ve served as an engineering point of contact for support escalations and stay calm and methodical when debugging live production systems under pressure.

  • AI-Forward: You leverage AI coding tools to maximize your speed and output — and are excited to help build AI-powered capabilities into the platform.

  • Startup DNA: Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable with ambiguity;
    you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment and communicate clearly across teams.

  • Bonus Points: FinTech, mortgage, or other regulated-industry experience;
    familiarity with LOS/POS platforms or the loan origination lifecycle is a strong plus.


What We Offer



  • Compensation: The US base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 – $180,000 + up to 15% performance-based bonus. The position is eligible for performance-based equity compensation. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level, and role;
    individual compensationwill be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Generous PTO policy.

  • Endless learning and growth opportunities in a fast-paced, growth-mode startup environment.

  • A supportive, inclusive, and high-performance company culture.



Note: ARIVE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

title: Remote Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer Ii (Frontend Leaning)
description:
ABOUT BESTOW

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.Gov.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The IPC Engineering team owns the custom implementation layer that powers Bestow's carrier and enterprise partner onboarding. We build the integrations, data mappings, and tailored experiences that bring each new partner live on the Bestow platform. We work across the full stack with a lean toward integration surfaces to deliver the end-to-end partner journey from configuration through launch. The team operates in a high-accountability domain where no two implementations are alike, and shipping means a carrier goes live.

Within Bestow Engineering, our major functional teams are product engineering, infrastructure, IT, data and analytics, mar-tech, and program management. IPC team works closely with Implementation Management, Technical Program Management, and platform engineering teams to translate partner requirements into production-ready solutions. We partner directly with carrier stakeholders, business systems analysts, and products to define scope and drive delivery.

This role reports to our Engineering Manager and is open to Remote (US).

#LI-REMOTE

ABOUT THE ROLE

The right candidate for this role will:

  • Lead frontend and fullstack implementation workstreams for carrier and enterprise partner integrations, owning the architecture and delivery of complex, partner-specific experiences from kickoff through production

  • Architect and implement scalable UI layers and API integrations, setting patterns for partner-facing surfaces that can be reused and extended across future implementations

  • Author high-quality RFCs with little guidance — identifying opportunities to turn one-off partner work into reusable, maintainable patterns that reduce build time for every implementation that follows

  • Partner with Implementation Managers, Business Systems Analysts, and TPMs to translate business requirements into well-scoped, actionable technical plans

  • Provide technical leadership in code reviews, delivering substantive architectural feedback that raises the quality bar across the team

  • Champion a consumer-first mindset — designing integrations that are intuitive for partner users and maintainable for the next engineer who touches the code

  • Champion engineering excellence through comprehensive testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage for all partner deliverables

  • Foster a security-first mindset within the team, identifying non-compliant code and ensuring reviewed contributions meet security requirements

  • Define AI coding tool standards and best practices for the vertical, balancing productivity gains with quality guardrails and measuring effectiveness over time

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with significant depth in React and TypeScript

  • Strong fullstack capability with professional experience in Go or Python

  • Understanding of GraphQL architecture, including schema design, performance optimization, resolver patterns, and the ability to guide architectural decisions around API design

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex implementation projects end-to-end, including scoping, RFC authorship, and delivery with cross-functional partners

  • Experience designing and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and building reliable integration layers between systems

  • Proven track record of delivering accessible, performant, and production-ready frontend solutions that balance technical quality with delivery timelines

  • Experience with modern frontend tooling including component libraries, build systems, and CI/CD pipelines

  • Strong communication skills;
    comfortable presenting technical topics and tradeoff decisions to engineering directors, implementation managers, and non-technical business stakeholders

  • Peer feedback that demonstrates this person is highly looked up to technically and as a collaborator

  • Experience with distributed systems or microservices preferred

  • Advocate for Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and incremental software delivery

  • Familiarity with AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) and the ability to evaluate AI-generated code critically for security, maintainability, and architectural alignment. Not just speed.

TOTAL REWARDS

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits include:

  • Competitive salary and equity based on role

  • Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs

  • 100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing

  • Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote

  • Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting

  • Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Recent Employer Awards include:

  • Best Place for Working Parents 2023 + 2024 + 2025

  • Great Place to Work Certified, 2022 + 2023 + 2024 + 2025

  • Built In Best Places to Work, 2022 + 2023 + 2025

  • Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Texas 2022 + 2023

  • Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance 2022 + 2023 + 2024

We value diversity at Bestow. The company will hire, recruit, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every team member.

Thanks for considering a job at Bestow!

title: 🏢 Officemanager
description:
Krijg jij energie van een goed georganiseerd kantoor? Vind jij het leuk om collega's én bezoekers een warm welkom te geven? Dan zoeken we jou.

Bij Realworks zoeken we een Officemanager die ervoor zorgt, dat collega's zich kunnen focussen op hun werk, omdat jij de rest regelt. Of het nu gaat om een goed georganiseerde werkplek, een warm welkom voor bezoekers of het organiseren van een bedrijfsfeest: jij houdt alle ballen moeiteloos in de lucht. Ondertussen zie je kansen om processen en de werkomgeving steeds een beetje beter te maken.

Je komt te werken in een internationale omgeving in het centrum van Amsterdam. Vanuit ons kantoor bouwen we met zo'n 130 collega's aan slimme software voor duizenden makelaars.

Wat deze functie zo leuk maakt? Geen dag is hetzelfde! De ene dag organiseer je een intern evenement, zoals een bedrijfsfeest of de Dam tot Damloop. De andere dag zorg je voor de ontvangst van bezoekers en regel je praktische zaken voor je collega's, zoals een NS Business Card. Je werkt rond de 25 uur per week en krijgt veel ruimte om de functie op jouw manier in te vullen.

🌟 Wat is jouw impact?

Dankzij jou is ons kantoor een fijne plek om te werken. Collega's richten zich volledig op hun werk, bezoekers voelen zich welkom en achter de schermen loopt het op rolletjes.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat ons kantoor representatief, verzorgd en goed georganiseerd is;

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor facilitaire zaken, leveranciers en gebouwbeheer;

  • Je coördineert de lunch en bent het aanspreekpunt voor Doua, onze lunchdame;

  • Je ontvangt bezoekers en zorgt voor een warm welkom;

  • Je organiseert interne evenementen: waaronder onze kwartaalfeesten, waarin we successen vieren, sportactiviteiten (de Dam tot Damloop) en tradities als het jaarlijks Sinterklaasfeest;

  • Het wagenpark, bedrijfsfietsen, NS Business Cards en telefoons; jij zorgt dat dit voor jouw collega’s geregeld is;

  • Je ondersteunt bij allerlei administratieve en organisatorische werkzaamheden, zoals het regelen van gebruikersovereenkomsten, bedrijfssoftware en bedrijf merchandise: bijvoorbeeld onze Hired sweater;

  • Je verrast collega's met attenties bij bijzondere momenten;

  • Je zorgt dat voor nieuwe collega's alles voor de eerste werkdag geregeld is, zodat ze direct goed kunnen starten.

🙌 Wat breng je mee?

Jij bent iemand die graag regelt, overzicht houdt en energie krijgt van een goed georganiseerde werkomgeving. Je wacht niet af, maar bent proactief. Je vindt het leuk om collega's te helpen en schakelt makkelijk tussen praktische -en organisatorische werkzaamheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt mbo+ werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je bent gastvrij en servicegericht;

  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk met collega's, leveranciers en bezoekers;

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (beetje Engels zou top zijn);

  • Je neemt initiatief en werkt zelfstandig;

  • Je houdt overzicht en hebt oog voor detail;

  • Je woont in de omgeving van Amsterdam;

  • Ervaring als Officemanager of in een vergelijkbare facilitaire functie is mooi meegenomen. Heb je niet de juiste ervaring, maar herken jij jezelf wel in deze rol? Dan nodigen we je graag uit om te solliciteren.

🎁 Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een afwisselende functie voor ongeveer 20-30 uur per week, bijvoorbeeld goed te combineren met het halen en brengen van (basis) schoolkinderen;

  • Veel vrijheid en eigenaarschap om de functie zelf vorm te geven;

  • Flexibele werktijden, waarbij je in ieder geval vier ochtenden per week op kantoor aanwezig bent;

  • Een fijne werkomgeving met betrokken collega's;

  • Ruimte voor initiatief en verbeterideeën.

Werken bij Realworks betekent ook:

  • Een goede balans tussen werk en privé;

  • Een gratis, gezonde lunch op kantoor;

  • Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden waar de functie dat toelaat;

  • Een modern kantoor in hartje Amsterdam, goed bereikbaar met het OV;

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van deur tot deur;

  • Een laptop;

  • Werken in zelfsturende teams met veel verantwoordelijkheid;

  • Gezellige borrels, kwartaalfeesten en teamactiviteiten;

  • 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bij te kopen;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling.

📅 Hoe ziet ons proces eruit?

  1. Solliciteren.

  2. Telefonische kennismaking.

  3. Eerste gesprek – we leren elkaar kennen en kijken of er een goede match is.

  4. Tweede gesprek – we gaan dieper in op de functie en jouw rol binnen Realworks.

  5. Welkom bij Realworks!

Een referentiecheck is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.

👋 Enthousiast?

Herken jij jezelf hierin en lijkt het je leuk om hét gezicht van ons kantoor te worden?

Bel of mail onze Recruiter Esther via +31 6 38159460 of recruitment@realworks.nl.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real-world impact, building iOS software in Swift that interfaces with regulated medical devices and is used every day by people who depend on it.   • Support verification, validation, and release activities, including the required quality system documentation.

  • Ensure compliance with the Quality Management System and applicable medical device standards.

  • Collaborate closely with usability, testing, systems, cloud, quality, and regulatory teams.

  • Contribute to building a best-in-class mobile development environment within a regulated context.

  • Stay current with iOS and mobile development trends, continuously raising the technical bar for the team.

📌 What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in software/computer engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • An extensive track record in iOS development with Swift, 5+ years of professional experience.

  • Experience across all development stages, including software architecture and design, testing, release, and maintenance.

  • Solid understanding of software testing practices for embedded applications, including unit and integration testing.

  • Strong technical writing and communication skills, with fluency in English.

  • A proven track record of delivering to time within a multi-disciplinary project team.

  • (preferred) experience in the medical devices or regulated software industry.

  • (preferred) familiarity with standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, and FDA 21 CFR 820.

  • (preferred) experience with automated testing for mobile applications, Android development, or cloud backend development for app data.

💡 Life at ViCentra

Working at ViCentra means joining a team defined by:

  • Courage to create: We experiment, challenge norms, and learn fast.

  • Trust above all: Integrity, honesty, and openness shape our relationships.

  • Customer-first mindset: Every idea is measured by the impact on those we serve.

  • A drive for excellence: We hold ourselves to the highest standard because lives depend on it.

Our days move fast, fueled by curiosity, diverse perspectives, and a love for collaboration. Here, you can shape and be shaped by groundbreaking work in MedTech.

🌱 Grow With Purpose

  • Harness your talent for a mission that truly matters.

  • Enjoy creative freedom, supportive teamwork, and room to lead initiatives.

  • Make a direct impact in people’s lives, today and into the future.

  • Be surrounded by innovators who challenge and cheer you on.

🌏 Every Journey Starts Somewhere — Make Yours Count Here

We believe a powerful team is built on unique backgrounds and points of view. If this opportunity excites you but you’re unsure if you fit every bullet, we want to hear your story. At ViCentra, it’s your potential and passion that catch our eye.
