title: Senior Cost Engineer
description:
Kent is looking for a Senior Cost Engineer based in Basra, Iraq.

As a Senior Cost Engineer embedded directly within the owner/operator’s project delivery team in Basra, Iraq, you will be responsible for the financial health, cost control, budgeting, and forecasting of major oil and gas capital projects. Acting as a key pillar in the project's financial governance, you will closely monitor project expenditures, manage change control, and ensure that all financial reporting is aligned with international joint-venture and asset-owner standards.

Skills and Responsibilities:
  • Track, analyze, and manage daily, weekly, and monthly project expenditures against approved budgets to ensure overall cost control.
  • Develop and maintain realistic Estimate at Completion (EAC) forecasts, cash flow curves, and contingency analyses.
  • Review, verify, and audit EPC and local contractor progress payment certificates, monthly invoices, and timesheets to validate actual progress versus billed costs.
  • Administer the variations and Change Order Request (COR) process, assessing the cost impact of positive or negative scope changes on the total project cost.
  • Generate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), purchase requisitions, and process Service Entry Sheets (SES) directly inside SAP.
  • Prepare comprehensive monthly cost reports, cost variance analyses, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for senior management and project shareholders.
  • Partner with Project Managers, Planning Engineers, and Procurement teams to flag budget overruns and identify cost-saving initiatives early.
Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:

Knowledge/ Qualification/ Training/ Certification:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, or Industrial), Quantity Surveying, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • 10 - 12 years of dedicated cost engineering or project controls experience specifically within the oil and gas sector (upstream, midstream, or gas processing).
  • Direct experience working on mega-projects or complex infrastructure upgrades within an operator or asset-owner environment is highly preferred (client-side experience vs. purely EPC contractor).
  • Prior experience working with major international oil companies (IOCs) or national oil companies (NOCs), including their specific commercial guidelines and project management frameworks.
  • Willing and able to work on a rotational schedule in Basra, Iraq. Excellent written and spoken English is mandatory for high-level reporting; conversational Arabic is highly preferred to interface effectively with local contractors.

Communication:

  • Excellent interpersonal and analytical attributes
  • Able to effectively communicate technical issues to peers and line manager (written and verbal)

Skills (Technical Competencies)

  • Mastery of SAP project system modules (WBS creation, PO tracking, and Service Entry Sheets).
  • High proficiency in MS Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, and macro-based data analysis) and cost-estimation databases.
  • Familiarity with FIDIC contract management standards, estimation methodologies, and progress measurement systems.
  • Practical capability in tracking physical progress against financial burn rates to deliver accurate performance indices (CPI/SPI).

Behavioural Core Competencies

  • Strict adherence to audit compliances and financial governance protocols.
  • A data-focused, meticulous approach to checking contractor claims and verifying invoice milestones.
  • Professional confidence to push back on unjustified contractor claims, undocumented variations, or mathematical discrepancies.
  • Ability to articulate complex financial variances, budget risks, and mitigation strategies clearly to non-financial project management teams.

Preferred Certifications (Optional)

  • Certified Cost Professional (CCP) or Certified Estimating Professional (CEP) via AACE International.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent execution credentials.
  • Formal SAP End-User or Super-User certification in Project Systems (PS).

title: Mekaniikka-asentaja, T-DRILL Oy
description:
T-DRILL Oy on maailman johtavia putkentyöstökoneiden valmistajia ja ratkaisutoimittajia. Yrityksen patentoidut ratkaisut putken liitoksiin ja katkaisuun sekä putken pään muotoiluun soveltuvat lukuisiin teollisuussovellutuksiin eri asiakastoimialoille. T-DRILLin juuret ovat Suomessa, markkinat maailmalla. Tuotteita viedään vuosittain yli 50 maahan ja viennin osuus on 98 %. Pääkonttori sijaitsee Laihialla, osavalmistus Isossakyrössä ja tytäryhtiö Atlantassa, USA:ssa. Työntekijöitä on kaikkiaan n. 100. T-Drill Oy kuuluu Leinolat Group konserniin. Lue lisää T-DRILL ja Leinolat Group

Etsimme asiakkaallemme T-DRILL Oy:lle mekaniikka-asentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?
Mekaniikka-asentajana vastaat T-DRILL Oy:n valmistamien putkentyöstökoneiden mekaniikka-, hydrauliikka- ja pneumatiikka-asennuksista. Työsi on monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä, ja pääset näkemään työn jäljen konkreettisesti osana laadukkaita koneitamme. Osallistut myös koneiden käyttöönottoon ja testaukseen, joissa varmistat, että jokainen kone toimii luotettavasti ja turvallisesti ennen toimitusta asiakkaalle.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen liukuvalla työajalla, jossa työpäivä alkaa klo 6.30–9.00 ja päättyy klo 15.00–17.00. Työskentelypisteesi sijaitsee Kurikassa Teollisuuskadulla ja työsuhde solmitaan suoraan T-DRILL Oy:n kanssa.

Mitä etsimme?
Etsimme asentajaa, jolla on soveltuva koulutustausta ja halu tehdä työnsä huolellisesti alusta loppuun. Odotamme sinulta järjestelmällistä ja tarkkaa työskentelyotetta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä vastuuntuntoista asennetta. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kykyä lukea ja tulkita teknisiä piirustuksia. Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta kone- ja laiteasennuksista, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme tekijää, joka nauttii teknisestä työstä ja oppii nopeasti uutta. Sujuva suomen kielen taito on tehtävässä välttämätön, ja englannin osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä me tarjoamme?
T-DRILLillä pääset osaksi vakavaraista yritystä ja työyhteisöä, jossa kollegat tukevat ja luottamus näkyy arjessa. Tarjoamme sinulle kilpailukykyisen palkan sekä kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten laajan työterveyshuollon Pihlajalinnassa, ePassin (liikunta, kulttuuri ja hyvinvointi) ja mahdollisuuden käyttää kuntosalia.

Pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa ja käytännönläheisissä tehtävissä laadukkaiden omavalmisteisten tuotteiden parissa. Saat tueksesi asiantuntevan, rennon ja kannustavan työyhteisön – eikä turhaan, sillä meidät on sertifioitu Great Place to Work -työnantajaksi.

Kiinnostuitko?
Laitahan hakemusta tulemaan! Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 23.8.2026. Hakuprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa ja valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan T-DRILL Oy:n omille kirjoille.

title: Remote Principal Backend Software Engineer
description:
Your Company:

As the Nonprofit Marketing Platform trusted by over 1,300 nonprofits, Feathr is purpose-built to help our customers unlock more results, time, and confidence.

Feathr's software marketing platform equips nonprofits with the tools they need to build purposeful connections with their community and grow impact with confidence.

We're working on building an amazing culture at Feathr, where amazing people (like you) can do their best work. If you're ready to grow and "help the helpers" you've come to the right place.

Principal Backend Software Engineer:

Compensation Range: $145,000 - $165,000 base, and a bonus potential of up to 12%
Benefits: Fully remote, Health/dental/vision insurance, Company Holidays + Winter Break, Paid vacation + sick time off


Your Work:

Feathr’s SaaS platform is critical to the value we deliver to our clients. Feathr’s Principal Engineers help us grow and maintain the technical components that allow us to meet our diverse customer base's advertising, marketing, and web analytics needs. A Principal Engineer at Feathr has demonstrated interest in and proficiency in web development.

You will work under the direction of the Associate Director of Product Engineering on backend software development projects. Engineers at Feathr own their code from planning to maintenance to retirement - you will work with internal and external stakeholders to develop requirements and design technical solutions, collaborate with your engineering colleagues to implement those solutions, deploy and monitor your changes in production, and address issues as they are identified.

Your Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on SaaS products.

  • Expertise in designing, building, and maintaining large-scale distributed systems.

  • Professional experience owning a process that includes shipping a complicated piece of software to real users

Your Technical Skills:

  • Working with both synchronous and asynchronous environments

  • Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Redis, and Python

  • Experience with Advanced ElasticSearch APIs

  • Expertise in MongoDB Queries and Aggregations, as well as regular maintenance

  • Expertise in AWS infrastructure and services (EC2 and EKS at a minimum)

  • Experience with self-hosted Drone CI/CD

Your Qualities:

  • Patience and determination to work through complex technical troubleshooting obstacles.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and manage relationships with internal and external partners.

  • Constantly look to hone your craft and share what you learn with your colleagues

  • Service-oriented team player who is here to achieve success for Feathr, The Product Team, and yourself

  • Pragmatic and customer-oriented - you are building software to help customers, not for the sake of building software

  • Comfortable adapting to quickly changing conditions. You might be working on one project but need to context switch to another unexpectedly during a critical outage.

  • Careful, detail-oriented approach to building software - ask questions first and write code later.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Your code solves immediate problems while building a sustainable system that lasts into the future.

  • Understand how to ingest and transform event streams from a variety of sources.

Your Day:

  • Plan and iterate over the product development lifecycle.

  • Work alongside other Product Team engineers to design and develop features.

  • Break down complex technical challenges into manageable work components, ensuring clear deliverables.

  • Receive feedback on your code and features and iterate.

  • Collaborate with members of other departments to ensure technical solutions meet the company's business interests.

  • Ensure the integrity, availability, and confidentiality of Feathr’s data and operations.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.


Compensation:

Starting salary for this position is $145,000 annually depending on experience and credentials, with the potential to earn an additional 12% of base salary.

Location:

This position is Remote to candidates located in Eastern and Central time zones or with the option to work from our headquarters in Gainesville, FL. If you aren’t familiar, Gainesville is a hip, mid-sized city with a highly innovative population and an attainable standard of living.


Interview Process:

As a part of our commitment to creating a fair, equitable, and positive interview experience for all candidates, we offer full transparency of our interview stages to give applicants an idea of the time and effort involved. Additionally, each interview stage consists of standardized questions and rubrics with a scoring system to ensure a consistent and fair assessment practice of all candidates.

  • HR Information Screen - The Talent Acquisition Team will invite candidates that move forward to a 20-30 minute virtual interview. This conversation will be focused on relevant work experience, compensation, role overview, and answering any questions the candidate has.

  • Hiring Manager Interview- 45 minute virtual meeting with to answer role-specific questions and dive deeper into your background and experience.

  • Work Assignment - Candidates will be given a work assignment prompt to complete a project that is relevant to the work they can expect in the role. You are given ample amount of time to complete this project before turning in.

  • Panel Interview - 1 hour interview with two to three key members of the team. This interview will dive deeper into the role, technical knowledge, and requirements of the position. You will also utilize this time to review any questions related to your work assignment.

  • Offer - The Talent Acquisition Team will reach out with the details of the offer to discuss with the candidate.

Interviewing at Feathr

We've prepared a comprehensive candidate resource that provides valuable insights and tips for interviewing at Feathr. It covers everything from common interview questions to helpful advice on how to make the most of your interview experience with us. Access the resource here.

We encourage all applicants to take advantage of this resource to help prepare for their interviews and gain a deeper understanding of what to expect when applying to join our Flock.

Benefits & Perks for full-time employees

We love our Flock and the work they do! But let’s be honest, life isn’t just about work. So we created a perks and benefits package that aims to help our team grow by including their wellness, families, passions, and personal time.

  • Fully remote

  • Full vision, dental, and ~99% health insurance for employees

  • Sick time off

  • Vacation time off

  • Extended Wintr Break

  • Parental Leave

  • Wellness Reimbursement Credit

  • Home Office Stipend

  • Professional Development Budget

  • Team hangouts and events

Culture:

Feathr defines culture as the secret sauce that makes our flock members want to come to work everyday and do their best work. Like every company, we have an acronym that conveys the most important aspects of the culture we strive to have.

  • Practicality: Progress Over Perfection

  • Ambition: When Feathr wins, We all win

  • Candor: Better communication, Better results

  • Trust: Assume the best, Share openly

  • Service: We exist to fix

This acronym is only as useful as the integrity of the people who reference it and believe in it. Every person at Feathr will face challenges, the most important quality is a commitment to work through those challenges with self-awareness and honesty.

Feathr is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, if you think you’d drive value in this position, please apply.

title: Senior Backend Java Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Java Engineer

Department: Beyond Sports

Location: Hungary, Budapest

Employment Type: FullTime

Senior Software Engineer (Java) at Beyond Sports

Join Our Team as a Senior Software Engineer (Java) at Beyond Sports!

Are you passionate about building scalable backend systems, driving technical architecture, and creating real-time sports technology that captures global audiences?

At Beyond Sports, we don’t just visualize sports, we reinvent how fans experience them. Together with partners like NFL, NHL, FIFA, and Disney, we push the boundaries of real-time sports data, 3D graphics, and AI-driven storytelling across web and native mobile platforms.

If you're an experienced Senior Java Engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment, excels as a Tech Lead within delivery squads, and wants to work with high-volume sports data, video streams, and live match feeds, this is the perfect next step in your career.

What Your Day Will Look Like

As a Senior Software Engineer (Java), you'll play a central role in building and scaling backend systems that power live fan engagement for millions of sports fans worldwide.

Working at the heart of our engineering delivery squads, you'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data Engineers, and Frontend Developers.

One day you might be architecting event-driven microservices to ingest live match data and commentary feeds. The next, you could be optimizing RESTful APIs for high concurrency during major sporting events, leading release deployments, or establishing technical guilds to drive Java best practices across the engineering chapter.

You'll serve as an effective Tech Lead, taking ownership of technical execution, mentoring fellow developers, and ensuring our codebases remain clean, maintainable, and built to scale under massive live loads.

What We Value

At Beyond Sports, we move fast, collaborate closely, and build things that haven't existed before.

You'll fit right in if you:

  • Take pride in writing clean, well-tested, and extensible code that sets the standard for the wider team

  • Drive clarity through exceptional verbal and technical communication with internal teams and external data providers

  • Embrace ownership of squad deliverables, effectively scoping, assigning, and tracking technical tasks

  • Bring a continuous growth mindset, establishing technical working groups and sharing new techniques

  • Value attention to detail in production software and ensure quality across every release environment

  • Lead and motivate fellow engineers with empathy, guiding their technical development through effective mentorship

Your Background

You don't need to tick every box, but we're generally looking for:

Expert Knowledge

  • Java Core: Proven expertise in Java 17+

  • Frameworks: Strong background with Spring Boot and Spring 5+

  • Data Persistence: Deep experience with JPA / Hibernate and relational databases (SQL)

  • Architecture: Hands-on experience designing and building Microservice Architectures and RESTful APIs

  • Version Control & Management: Mastery of Git workflows and Jira for task management

  • Quality Assurance: Commitment to comprehensive Unit Testing and technical documentation

Competent With

  • Streaming & Event Systems: Kafka or similar message brokers

  • Containerization & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS products

  • Build & CI/CD: Maven and Continuous Integration pipelines

Understanding Of

  • Python scripting

  • Web basics (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

Optional & Extended Responsibilities

Depending on your career goals and squad setup, this role offers room to take on expanded leadership responsibilities:

  • Engineering Mentorship: Leading and motivating team members to build their technical skills and fulfill their potential

  • Line Management: Providing line management for developers (up to 1 day per week), including performance reviews, 1:1 support, and career mapping

  • Chapter & Guild Leadership: Acting as a Chapter Lead for backend development or founding technical Guilds/Working Groups to drive engineering standards across the company

Why Level Up Your Career at Beyond Sports

Fast-moving, creative, and innovative — that's our world.

  • Global Scale: Build backend systems that process real-time data for millions of global sports fans

  • Tech Leadership: Drive architecture decisions, technical guilds, and engineering standards

  • Data Variety: Work with live match feeds, video streaming, 3D graphics data, and AI-driven content

  • Growth Culture: Structured paths into Chapter Lead, Principal Engineer, or Engineering Management roles

  • Real Collaboration: Partner directly with specialized engineers, product managers, and sports domain experts

Ready to Bring the Beyond Sports Brand to Life?

If you're excited about architecting high-performance Java systems, leading engineering squads, and contributing to a brand that's helping redefine sports entertainment, we'd love to hear from you.

At Beyond Sports, you won't just write code. You'll help bring sports to life.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Solutions Engineers at Axle build the integrations and technical infrastructure that enable our customers to connect distributed energy devices, orchestrate them, and participate in electricity markets.

This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. You will work closely with our customers to understand their technical requirements, build integrations, solve complex technical challenges, and help shape our product based on real world feedback.

We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

Solutions Engineering at Axle looks like

  • Forming a deep understanding of our domain, our platform, and our customers' technical challenges, so you have enough context to execute at speed.

  • Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms.

  • Working closely with customers to troubleshoot technical issues, support implementations, and design scalable solutions.

  • Steering customers towards a more direct launch plan and a better user experience.

  • Collaborating closely with our Product team to turn customer feedback into product improvements.

  • Focus on outcomes rather than process, taking ownership of the quality and impact of the final product you deliver.

  • Manage your own time and support others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, to deliver 80% of the value in 20% of the time

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

☁️ We deploy on GCP

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Remote pair programming

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: Remote Power Bi & Front-End Data Visualization Developer
